blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Reasoning across videos requires aligning events, matching identities, comparing motion, and integrating partial observations. Evaluating these capabilities and testing how to improve them requires both reliable labels and targeted supervision. We introduce SYNCR, a simulator-grounded framework that connects these two needs through shared task generators. Built on Habitat, Kubric, and CLEVRER, SYNCR derives answers from environment state and provides 4,000 evaluation questions and 15,960 training questions over disjoint videos, spanning eight cross-video reasoning tasks. Visual ablations and human evaluation assess dependence on the supplied evidence and answer recoverability.
Evaluation of 22 multimodal large language models reveals persistent difficulties in physical comparison and scene integration that increasing model size does not consistently resolve. Supervised fine-tuning raises Qwen3-VL-8B’s average SYNCR accuracy from 32.6% to 61.6%, with gains extending to task configurations and video sources absent from training for those tasks. Transfer to real footage is most consistent for temporal ordering: accuracy improves by 9.0–20.5 percentage points on constructed Assembly101 and Panoptic ordering sets across three checkpoints spanning two model families and two model sizes, with additional gains on existing temporal reasoning benchmarks. These results establish SYNCR as a controlled setting for diagnosing cross-video reasoning failures, testing their learnability, and identifying where synthetic supervision transfers.
blocks.zh:
跨视频的理性需要调整事件,匹配身份,对比运动,整合部分观察. 评估这些能力并测试如何改进这些能力,需要可靠的标签和有针对性的监督。 我们引入了SYNCR(SYNCR),这是一个通过共享任务生成器将这两种需求连接起来的模拟基框架. SYNCR建于Hebit, Kubric, 和CLEVRER之上, 由环境状态提供答案, 视觉碎片和人类评价评估对所提供证据的依赖性并回答可恢复性。
对22个多式联运大语言模型的评价表明,在物理比较和场景整合方面一直存在困难,而模型规模的不断扩大并不能持续解决这些困难。 监督的微调将Qwen3-VL-8B的平均SYNCR精度从32.6%提升到61.6%,收益扩展到任务配置和视频来源,没有为这些任务提供培训。 转录到真实镜头对于时间顺序来说最为一致:在建造的Assembly101和Panoptic订购装置上,精度提高了9.0-20.5个百分点,跨越两个模范家庭和两个模范规模的3个检查站,在现有时间推理基准上取得了额外进展。 这些结果将SYNCR确立为诊断交叉视频推理失败,测试其可学习性,并确定合成监督转移地点的可控环境.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Multiple videos can provide complementary evidence about an environment, but understanding each video independently is insufficient to answer questions about their relationships. Counting distinct objects across overlapping camera views requires recognizing repeated sightings; reconstructing an event from shuffled clips requires relating its progression across segments. Such tasks demand cross-video reasoning: aligning events, matching identities, comparing behavior, and integrating partial observations. Which of these capabilities remain difficult for current multimodal large language models, and can targeted supervision improve them?
blocks.zh: 多段视频可以提供环境的互补证据,但独立地理解每段视频不足以回答有关他们关系的问题. 盘点相机重叠视线的不同物体,需要识别反复的目击;从被冲洗的片段重建一个事件,需要将它的跨段进展联系起来。 这类任务需要交叉视频推理:对齐事件,匹配身份,比较行为,整合部分观测. 对于目前的多式联运大语言模式而言,这些能力中哪些仍然很困难,目标明确的监督能够改进这些能力?

blocks.en: Answering these questions requires connecting evaluation with controlled learning experiments. Real-footage benchmarks such as MVU-Eval, CVBench, and CrossVid capture diverse multi-video settings, but precise temporal offsets, three-dimensional relationships, and kinematic quantities are difficult to annotate at scale. Ambiguous visual evidence and textual shortcuts can also complicate the interpretation of model errors and successes. Simulation offers access to the state underlying each observation, enabling both programmatic labeling and the generation of targeted supervision. However, a simulator-derived answer is useful for evaluating visual reasoning only if it is recoverable from the supplied videos. A complementary framework must therefore combine grounded labels, evidence controls, and tests of generalization beyond its training conditions.
blocks.zh: 回答这些问题需要将评价与有控制的学习实验联系起来。 MVU-Eval,CV Bench,CrossVid等实足基准捕获了多种多视频设置,但准确的时间抵消,三维关系,动量等都难以在规模上进行注释. 模糊的视觉证据和文字快捷方式也会使模型错误和成功的解释复杂化. 模拟提供了对每项观察的基础状态的利用,使方案标签和产生有针对性的监督成为可能。 然而,模拟生成的答案只有在从提供的视频中可回收的情况下,才有助于评价视觉推理。 因此,一个补充框架必须结合有根据的标签、证据控制和超出训练条件的通用性测试。

blocks.en: We introduce SYNCR, a simulator-grounded framework that uses the same task generators to diagnose cross-video reasoning failures and test their learnability. Built on Habitat, Kubric, and CLEVRER, SYNCR derives answers from temporal offsets, object identities, trajectories, and scene geometry, while models receive only RGB videos, questions, and answer options. Eight tasks cover temporal alignment, spatial tracking, comparative reasoning, and holistic synthesis. The generators produce 4,000 evaluation questions and 15,960 training questions over disjoint videos. Text-only and single-video ablations assess shortcuts and dependence on multiple inputs, while human evaluation assesses whether answers are recoverable from the RGB videos.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了SYNCR,一个模拟基于的框架,它使用同样的任务生成器来诊断跨视频推理失败并测试其学习能力. SYNCR基于栖息地,Kubric,以及CLEVRER,从时间偏移,对象身份,轨迹,场景几何中得出答案,而模型只接收RGB视频,问答选项. 8项任务包括时间调整、空间跟踪、比较推理和整体综合。 发电机制作4 000个评价问题和15 960个培训问题,涉及脱节视频。 仅文本和单视频的拼写评估捷径和对多种输入的依赖,而人评价则评估答案是否可以从RGB视频中恢复.

blocks.en: Across 22 models, SYNCR reveals uneven capabilities: chronological ordering can be strong while physical comparison and scene integration remain difficult, including at larger model sizes. These failures are nevertheless responsive to targeted supervision. On matched sets of 200 items per task, eight-task supervised fine-tuning raises Qwen3-VL-8B’s average accuracy from 32.6% to 61.6%, and improves performance under changes to task structure and video source. The framework thus connects observed weaknesses to direct tests of whether training can address them.
blocks.zh: 在整个22个模型中,SYNCR揭示出能力不均匀:时间顺序可能很强,而物理比较和场景整合仍然很困难,包括模型尺寸较大. 然而,这些失败是对目标明确的监督的反应。 在匹配的200套每件任务上,八任务监督的微调将Qune3-VL-8B的平均精度从32.6%提高到61.6%,并在任务结构和视频源的变化下提高了性能. 因此,该框架将观察到的薄弱环节与直接测试培训能否解决这些问题联系起来。

blocks.en: Real-video evaluations then test the reach of these improvements. Temporal ordering transfers across constructed Assembly101 and Panoptic sets, with gains of 9.0–20.5 percentage points across three checkpoints from two model families. Improvements on existing temporal reasoning benchmarks provide further evidence beyond our constructed evaluations, while results on other tasks remain mixed. Together, these experiments contribute grounded task generators, matched evaluation and training resources, and a controlled study of which cross-video capabilities can be improved through synthetic supervision and where those improvements generalize.
blocks.zh: 然后进行真实的视频评价,测试这些改进的范围。 临时订购Assembly101和Panoptic成套设备,从两个模范家庭的3个检查站获得9.0-20.5个百分点。 现有时间推理基准的改进为我们构建的评价之外提供了进一步的证据,而其他任务的成果则参差不齐。 这些实验共同贡献了有根有底的任务产生者,匹配了评价和培训资源,并且对通过合成监督可以提高跨视频能力的可控研究以及这些改进的普遍之处。

blocks.en: Figure 1: The SYNCR framework. Eight tasks in four families: temporal alignment across streams, identity and geometry across viewpoints, physical and numerical comparison, and integration of partial scene observations. Simulator-derived answers support both evaluation and targeted training.
blocks.zh: 图1:SYNCR框架. 4个家庭的8项任务:跨流的时间调整、不同观点的特征和几何、物理和数字比较以及部分场景观测的整合。 模拟生成的答案支持评价和有针对性的培训。

blocks.en: 2 SYNCR: Tasks and Data Construction
blocks.zh: 2 SYNCR:任务和数据构建

blocks.en: SYNCR uses eight task generators for both evaluation and training. Each generator renders or selects multiple video clips, computes an answer from simulator state, and constructs a question designed to require relating the clips. This shared construction lets us measure a task-level failure and then test whether supervision on that task improves it. Evaluation and training use disjoint videos; later experiments vary task structure and video source to test whether gains extend beyond the training.
blocks.zh: SYNCR使用8个任务生成器进行评价和培训. 每个生成器会制作或选择多个视频剪辑,从模拟状态计算一个答案,并构造一个设计成需要连接剪辑的问题. 这一共同建设让我们能够衡量任务层面的失败,然后检验对这项任务的监督是否改善了它。 评估和培训使用脱节的视频;后来的实验会改变任务结构和视频来源,以测试收益是否超出培训范围.

blocks.en: 2.1 Diagnostic Task Families
blocks.zh: 2.1 诊断性任务家庭

blocks.en: We group the eight tasks into four diagnostic families (Fig. 1 ). Temporal Alignment relates events across time; Spatial Tracking connects identities and positions across views; Comparative Reasoning compares motion or events between videos; and Holistic Synthesis combines partial observations of a scene. The families organize the task-level results; they are not assumed to be independent abilities. This organization exposes failures that an eight-task average would hide.
blocks.zh: 我们把八项任务分成四个诊断家庭(图1)。 (a) 比较理性比较视频之间的运动或事件; 家庭负责组织任务层面的成果;他们不被认为是独立的能力。 这个组织揭露了八项任务平均值会掩盖的失败.

blocks.en: Temporal Alignment. Multi-Angle Synchronization presents three independently cropped camera views of one event and asks for the start times of Videos 2 and 3 relative to Video 1. Solving it requires matching moments despite changes in viewpoint. Sequential Ordering instead shuffles four segments from one continuous video and asks for their chronological order. Gaps between segments prevent matching adjacent boundary frames directly; the model must use event progression and object motion. Ordering therefore tests a different temporal relation from synchronization across cameras.
blocks.zh: 时间调整。 多角同步显示一个事件的三个独立裁剪的相机视图,并询问视频2和3相对于视频1的起始时间. 解决它需要匹配的瞬间 尽管观点有变化。 顺序顺序代替从一个连续视频中洗掉四个片段,并询问其时间顺序. 区段之间的间隔会阻止直接匹配相邻边界框架;模型必须使用事件进化和对象运动. 因此,订购测试与相机同步不同的时间关系。

blocks.en: Spatial Tracking. Object Re-identification presents two indoor walkthroughs, identifies an object’s visibility window in Video 1, and asks when the same object first appears in Video 2. Spatial Measurement shows a dynamic scene from two cameras and asks which object is closest in 3D to a target when another object leaves a designated view. The departure fixes the time of comparison; the two projections must be reconciled because image-plane proximity need not match 3D distance.
blocks.zh: 空间跟踪。 对象重识别呈现两个室内走过, 在 Video 1 中识别对象的可见窗口, 并询问同一对象何时在 Video 中首次出现 2.空间测量从两个摄像头显示一个动态场景,并询问当另一个物体离开指定的视图时,哪个物体在3D中最接近目标. 离开决定了比较的时间;两个预测必须调和,因为图像-飞机的相近性不需要匹配3D距离.

blocks.en: Comparative Reasoning. Kinematic Comparison asks which of four candidate objects—the two fastest in each of two videos—reaches the highest peak speed. Numerical Comparison asks which video has more collisions and by how many, allowing ties. Both compare evidence across videos, but one depends on estimating motion over time and the other on counting discrete events.
blocks.zh: 比较理性. Kinematic Association询问四个候选对象中的哪一个是最高时速, 数字比较询问哪个视频有较多的碰撞和多少,允许链接. 两者都比较跨视频的证据,但一个取决于随着时间的推移对运动的估计,另一个取决于计算离散事件.

blocks.en: Holistic Synthesis. Object Counting asks for the number of distinct objects in two or three named categories across three indoor walkthroughs; repeated sightings of one object count once. Route Planning presents three partial route clips and asks for the shortest path between rooms identified by their objects. Counting requires linking repeated sightings, while routing requires joining room connections shown in separate clips.
blocks.zh: 综合综合. 对象计数要求分两个或三个命名类别,跨越三个室内走行道的明显对象数量;一次重复一个物体的目击数. 路由规划提供了三个部分路由剪辑,并要求在由它们的对象所确定的房间之间找到最短的路由. 计数需要连接重复的目击,而路由则需要连接单独片段显示的房间连接.

blocks.en: 2.2 Simulator-Grounded Item Construction
blocks.zh: 2.2 模拟-圆形物品建造

blocks.en: Each generator uses simulator annotations to select clips, compute the answer, and build answer options. Shared instance IDs establish correspondence across views; positions, velocities, and collision records determine spatial and physical answers; and crop start times determine temporal labels. Models receive only RGB clips, questions, and options. We use the annotations to label and filter items, not as model input. Exact simulator labels do not by themselves establish that an answer is visible, so Sec. 3.3 and App. A.1 report evidence controls and implementation details.
blocks.zh: 每个生成器使用模拟说明来选择剪辑,计算答案,并构建答案选项. 共享实例ID可以建立各种观点之间的对应关系;位置、速度和碰撞记录决定空间和物理答案;作物起始时间决定时间标签。 模型只接收RGB剪辑,问题和选项. 我们用说明来标记和过滤项目,而不是作为模型输入. 精确模拟标签本身并不能确定一个答案是可见的,因此第3.3条和App.A.1条报告证据控制和执行细节.

blocks.en: Habitat. We render 100-frame egocentric trajectories at 5 FPS in the 216 densely annotated HM3D scenes ( Ramakrishnan et al., 2021 ) ; each trajectory ends with a panoramic sweep. Per-frame instance masks supply the visibility windows for Object Re-identification and the distinct instance counts for Object Counting, while navigation graphs supply Route Planning answers. Rooms are described by their three rarest objects. We require re-identified objects to appear for at least five consecutive frames and counted objects to occupy at least 5% of a frame in one view, filtering out instances with little visual exposure.
blocks.zh: 栖息处. 在216场HM3D剧情(Ramakrishnan等人,2021年)中, 每帧实例掩码提供对象重新识别的可见度窗口和对象计数的明显实例,而导航图则提供路由规划答案. 房间由三个最稀有的物体来描述. 我们要求重新识别的对象至少连续出现五个帧,并计算对象在一个视图中至少占据一个帧的5%,从而过滤出几乎没有视觉曝光的地方。

blocks.en: Kubric. We simulate 10–15 moving objects with collisions and render each scene for 5 s at 12 FPS from three synchronized cameras. Independent 3-second crops set the Multi-Angle Synchronization offsets relative to Video 1. The cameras share object identities, but visibility is computed separately for each view. For Spatial Measurement, simulator positions give 3D distances at the time of the event specified in the question.
blocks.zh: 库布里克 我们用碰撞模拟10-15个移动物体,从三个同步摄像头使每个场景在12 FPS时达到5秒。 独立3秒作物设置多角同步比对视频1抵消. 相机共享对象身份,但能见度则为每个视图分别计算. 对于空间测量,模拟位置在问题指定的事件发生时给出3D距离.

blocks.en: CLEVRER. We reuse the original videos and derive answers from their trajectory, velocity, and collision annotations. Sequential Ordering uses four shuffled clips with 0.3–0.6 s gaps. For Kinematic Comparison, we require a speed margin of at least 0.25 between the cross-video maximum and its competitors and between each video’s two fastest objects, reducing near ties. Numerical Comparison compares annotated collision counts; ties make up one fifth of its evaluation items.
blocks.zh: 克莱弗瑞尔。 我们重用原始的视频,并从他们的轨迹、速度和碰撞说明中得出答案。 顺序排列使用4个有0.3–0.6s间隙的洗牌片段. 在Kinematic比较中, 我们要求跨视频最大值与其竞争对手之间, 以及每个视频两个最快的物体之间, 数字比较比较附加说明的碰撞数;联系占评价项目的五分之一。

blocks.en: Distractor Design. We construct incorrect options to resemble valid answers: synchronization distractors come from independently sampled crop offsets, re-identification distractors from visibility windows with similar timings, and route distractors from paths with similar hop counts. Ordering alternatives follow the answer permutation frequencies; numerical alternatives use incorrect video identities and count differences. These choices limit cues in the options, which we assess with text-only audits (App. A.3.2 ).
blocks.zh: 灾情设计. 我们构建不正确的选项来类似有效的答案:同步分光器来自独立取样的作物偏移,重新识别分光器来自具有类似时间的可见度窗口,以及路由分光器来自具有类似hop计数的路径。 排序的替代品遵循解答传动频率;数字替代品使用不正确的视频身份和计数差异. 这些选择限制了选项中的提示,我们仅通过文字审计来评估这些选项(App.A.3.2)。

blocks.en: 2.3 Evaluation and Training Splits
blocks.zh: 2.3 评价和培训

blocks.en: The benchmark contains 500 questions per task: 4,000 questions referencing 4,827 distinct video files across tasks. The training set contains 15,960 questions referencing 14,956 distinct video files across tasks, with no video file shared between the evaluation and training splits (Table 4 ; App. A.2 ). Each question presents two to four clips. Answer categories and option letters are balanced both in the first 200 and across all 500 evaluation items per task, limiting answer-frequency cues. The held-out videos test learning beyond the rendered training examples.
blocks.zh: 基准包括每个任务的500个问题:4 000个问题,参照4 827个不同任务的视频文件。 这套培训包括15 960个问题,涉及14 956个不同的视频文件,涉及不同任务,没有共享视频文件(表4;App.A.2)。 每一个问题都有两到四个片段。 答题类别和选项字母在每项任务前200个评价项目和所有500个评价项目中都是平衡的,限制了答题频率提示。 被搁置的视频测试了学习 超越了培训的例子。

The 17 standard open-weight checkpoints and the Thinking checkpoint use 500 questions per task; proprietary models † and the four-person human majority vote use the same first 100. Bold and underline mark the best and second-best results among the 17 standard open-weight checkpoints. Chance is 25%, except for Num (20%).
blocks.zh: 表1:SYNCR上的零射精度(%). Avg是8项任务的未加权平均值。 17个标准开放量检点和思维检点每任务使用500个问题;专有型 和四人多数投票使用相同的前100个. 在17个标准的露天检查站中,大胆地强调最佳和次佳成绩。 机会为25%,但努姆除外(20%)。

blocks.en: 3 Evaluating Cross-Video Reasoning
blocks.zh: 3 评价交叉视频理由

blocks.en: We first ask which SYNCR tasks current models solve, then test whether their answers depend on the intended video evidence. Table 1 reports the task-level results; Fig. 3 summarizes the visual-evidence controls.
blocks.zh: 我们首先询问哪个SYNCR任务当前模型解决,然后测试他们的答案是否依赖于预期的视频证据. 表1报告了任务一级的结果;图3概述了视觉证据控制。

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Models. The 22 evaluated models comprise 17 standard open-weight checkpoints (0.5B–72B parameters) from Qwen2.5-VL ( Bai et al., 2025b ) , Qwen3-VL ( Bai et al., 2025a ) , InternVL3 ( Zhu et al., 2025a ) , InternVL3.5 ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , and LLaVA-OneVision ( Li et al., 2024a ) ; Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking; and four proprietary models: Gemini-3-Flash ( Google DeepMind, 2025 ) , Gemini-3.1-Pro ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) , GPT-5.4 ( OpenAI, 2026a ) , and GPT-6 Astra ( OpenAI, 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 模特儿们 22个评价模型包括来自Qun2.5-VL(Bai等人,2025年b)的17个标准开放重量检查站(0.5B-72B参数),Qun3-VL(Bai等人,2025年a),InternVL3(Zhu等人,2025年a),InternVL3.5(Wang等人,2025年)和LLAVA-One Visionsion(Li等人,2024年a),Qun3-VL-8B-Thinking;以及四个专利模型:Gemini-3-Flash(Google DeepMind,2025年),Gemini-3.1-Pro (Google DeepMind,2026),GPT-5.4(OpenAI,2026a),以及GPT-6 Astra(OpenAI,2026b).

blocks.en: Protocol. Models answer zero-shot multiple-choice questions with inputs labeled Video 1 , Video 2 , etc. We score the parsed final answer and use deterministic decoding where supported (App. B.1 ). The 17 standard open-weight checkpoints and Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking receive 500 items per task. Proprietary models and the human reference receive the same first 100. Chance is 25% on seven tasks and 20% on Numerical Comparison. We compare models on matched items when testing differences and report 95% Wilson intervals for accuracy and exact two-sided McNemar tests for paired comparisons (App. B.3 ).
blocks.zh: 协议。 模型用编号为Video 1,Video 2等的输入回答零镜头多选择问题. 我们得到解析的最后答案,并在所支持的地方使用决定性解码(App.B.1 )。 17个标准开放重量检查站和Qune3-VL-8B-Thinking每任务接收500件物品. 专有模型和人类参考获得相同的前100. 7项任务的概率为25%,数字比较为20%。 我们在测试差异时比较匹配项目的模型,并报告95%的威尔逊间隔,精确的双侧麦克尼玛测试,以进行配对比较(App.B.3).

blocks.en: Human reference. Four graduate students independently answer the 100-item sets from RGB videos, questions, and options, without simulator annotations. We report majority-vote accuracy and score tied votes as incorrect (App. B.2 ). This four-person reference measures what viewers can recover together; it is not an estimate of individual human accuracy.
blocks.zh: 人文参考. 四名研究生独立回答RGB视频中的百项集,问题,和选项,没有模拟说明. 我们报告多数选票的准确性,并将附带条件的票数定为不正确(App.B.2)。 这种四人参照度量法是观众可以一起恢复的;它不是个人准确性的估计.

blocks.en: 3.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 3.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Large gaps remain on the matched human items. GPT-6 Astra averages 64.5%, versus 89.5% for the human majority vote on the same 100 items per task (Table 1 ). Among the standard open-weight checkpoints, Qwen3-VL 32B has the highest eight-task average, 37.5% on 500 items per task; seven of the 17 average below 27%. The 100-item and 500-item scores use different subsets and should not be treated as a precise cross-group ranking.
blocks.zh: 在相应的人类物品上还存在着很大的差距。 GPT-6 Astra平均为64.5%,而多数人对同样100项任务投了89.5%票(表1)。 在标准开放重量检查点中,Qwen3-VL 32B的平均八项任务最高,每项任务500件占37.5%;平均17项中的7项低于27%。 100项和500项分数使用不同的子集,不应作为精确的跨组排名处理.

blocks.en: The two temporal tasks separate sharply. On Sequential Ordering, GPT-6 Astra reaches 100% and Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking 76.6%. On Multi-Angle Synchronization, GPT-6 Astra reaches 88% and Gemini-3.1-Pro 60%, but the 17 standard open-weight checkpoints score only 21.8–31.0%, around the 25% chance level. Ordering gapped segments from one recording and matching moments across camera views therefore present different difficulties.
blocks.zh: 两个时间性的任务 完全分开。 在顺序排序上,GPT-6 Astra达到100%,Qune3-VL-8B-Thinking达到76.6%. 在多角度同步上,GPT-6 Astra达到了88%,双子座3.1-Pro达到了60%,但17个标准开放重量检查点的得分只有21.8-31.0 %,约为25%的机会水平. 因此,从一个录制和相匹配的瞬间对一段进行分层排列会遇到不同的困难。

blocks.en: Physical comparison and scene integration remain difficult. The highest standard open-weight score on Kinematic Comparison is 29.8%; no proprietary model exceeds 20% on its 100-item set. The human majority vote reaches 68%, suggesting that this task is difficult even for unaided viewers. On Object Counting and Route Planning, standard open-weight scores reach at most 30.4% and 32.8%, while the human majority vote reaches 92% and 88% on its matched set. These task-level gaps identify where aggregate accuracy hides persistent failures.
blocks.zh: 物理比较和场景整合仍然很困难。 Kinematic Compare上的最高标准开放量分为29.8%;在其100项集上,无专有模型超过20%. 人类多数的选票达到68%,这表明这一任务即使对于没有援助的观众来说也是困难的. 在对象计数和路由规划方面,标准开放加权得分最高达到30.4%和32.8%,而人类多数的选票则达到92%和88%。 这些任务层面的差距查明了总体准确性掩盖持续失败之处。

blocks.en:
The Thinking checkpoint has mixed temporal results. Against Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on the same 500 items per task, the Thinking checkpoint raises Sequential Ordering from 56.4% to 76.6% but lowers Multi-Angle Synchronization from 29.6% to 23.8% (App. B.3.1 ). Because the checkpoints differ in post-training, this comparison does not isolate the effect of deliberation alone. Scaling gains vary by model family. Qwen3-VL’s average rises from 25.8% at 2B to 37.5% at 32B, and InternVL3.5’s from 24.6% at 1B to 34.3% at 38B; LLaVA-OneVision stays between 23.8% and 25.2% across 0.5B–72B (Fig. 2 ). Within Qwen3-VL, the clearest gains are on Sequential Ordering and Object Re-identification, while several other tasks change little or non-monotonically.
At Qwen3-VL sizes of 4B, 8B, and 32B, Kinematic Comparison remains below chance, while Spatial Measurement and Object Counting vary non-monotonically (App. B.3 ). Model size alone therefore does not remove every task-level failure.
blocks.zh:
思考检查站的时间结果好坏参半。 针对每个任务相同的500项的Quen3-VL-8B-指示,思维检查站将顺序顺序顺序从56.4%提高到76.6%,但将多角度同步率从29.6%降到23.8%(App.B.3.1)。 由于各检查站在训练后情况不同,这种比较并不孤立审议的效果。 扩大收益因家庭模式而异。 Qune3-VL的平均增长率从2B的25.8%上升到32B的37.5%,而InnVL3.5的平均增长率从1B的24.6%上升到38B的34.3%;LLaVA-One Vision在0.5B-72B的23.8%和25.2%之间(图2)。 在Qwen3-VL中,最明显的收益在于顺序排列和对象重新识别,而其他几个任务变化不大或没有变化。
在4B,8B,和32B的Quen3-VL尺寸上,Kinematics比较仍然低于偶然性,而空间测量和对象计数则在非当量性上有所不同(App. B.3. 因此,单靠模型大小并不能消除每个任务级别的失败.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Zero-shot SYNCR accuracy by model size. Points show the eight-task mean for each plotted open-weight checkpoint (500 items per task). Dashed lines mark GPT-6 Astra and Gemini-3.1-Pro (100 items per task); the dotted line marks the 24.4% mean chance rate.
blocks.zh: 图2:按模型大小划分的零射SYNCR精度. 点数显示每个规划的开放式检查站的八任务平均值(每任务500件). 虚线标记为GPT-6 Astra和双子座-3.1-Pro(每任务100项);虚线标记为24.4%的平均概率率。

blocks.en: 3.3 Validity Checks
blocks.zh: 3.3 有效性检查

blocks.en: Simulator state supplies exact labels, but the evaluation must also test whether a model needs the intended visual evidence. We remove all videos or retain one randomly selected video while holding the question and options fixed; we also check whether crop timestamps reveal answers (Fig. 3 ; App. A.3 ).
blocks.zh: 模拟状态提供准确的标签,但评价还必须测试一个模型是否需要预期的视觉证据. 我们删除所有视频或保留一个随机选择的视频,同时持有问题和选项固定;我们还检查作物时间戳是否显示答案(图3;App. A.3).

blocks.en: Figure 3: Visual-evidence controls (zero-shot). For each item, the question and options stay fixed while the model receives all videos, one randomly selected video, or no video. Qwen3-VL-32B’s all-video and one-video results use the first 200 items, while its no-video result uses all 500; the latter is therefore not a paired comparison.
blocks.zh: 图3:视觉证据控制(零镜头). 对于每个项目,在模型接收所有视频,一个随机选择的视频,或者没有视频时,问题和选项保持不变. Qune3-VL-32B的全视频和单视频结果使用前200项,而其无视频结果则使用全部500项;因此后者不是一对比较.

blocks.en: Text alone provides little signal. Without videos, Qwen3-VL 8B and 32B and LLaVA-OneVision 72B remain within the chance interval on every task. GPT-6 Astra, explicitly asked to guess, averages 22.3% and exceeds the chance interval on no task. Audited text-only rules also fail to solve the tasks reliably (App. A.3.2 ). These zero-shot controls do not establish that trained models remain free of textual shortcuts; Sec. 4.4 tests that separately.
blocks.zh: 单是文本就没有什么信号。 没有视频,Qwen3-VL 8B和32B以及LLaVA-One Vision 72B仍然停留在每项任务的机会间隔内. GPT-6 Astra,明确要求猜测,平均22.3%,在无任务时超过机会间隔. 已审计的文本规则也未能可靠地解决这些任务(App. A.3.2.)。 这些零镜头控制不能确定训练有素的模型仍然没有文字快捷键; Sec. 4.4 分别进行测试.

blocks.en: Removing clips reduces accuracy on several tasks. Keeping one randomly selected video reduces Qwen3-VL 32B’s Sequential Ordering accuracy from 66.0% to 24.5%, and GPT-6 Astra’s Multi-Angle Synchronization accuracy from 88% to 12% and Numerical Comparison accuracy from 60% to 4%. The reduction is not universal: Qwen3-VL 32B still reaches 39.5% on Object Re-identification with one video, versus 56.0% with all videos. For tasks already near chance with all videos, this ablation has little ability to reveal a further loss. The controls support a multi-video interpretation most clearly where full-input accuracy is above chance.
blocks.zh: 删除剪辑会降低若干任务的准确性. 保持一个随机选择的视频将Quen3-VL 32B的顺序定型精度从66.0%降至24.5%,GPT-6 Astra的多角度同步精度从88%降至12%,数字比较精度从60%降至4%. 降幅并不普遍:Qwen3-VL 32B仍然通过一台视频在对象重新识别上达到39.5%,而所有视频的降幅为56.0%. 对于所有视频已经接近机会的任务,这种衰竭几乎无法揭示进一步的损失. 控制最明确地支持多视频解释,即完全输入准确性高于机会。

blocks.en: Source timestamps do not reveal temporal labels. Training and evaluation videos are disjoint. Source-video timestamps are removed from cropped inputs, while elapsed time within each clip is retained. Thus, timestamp markers cannot directly reveal the Sequential Ordering sequence or Multi-Angle Synchronization offsets (App. A.3.1 ).
blocks.zh: 源时间戳不显示时间标签. 培训与评价录像互不关联。 从已收割的投入中去除源图像时间戳,同时保留每个片段中经过的时间。 因此,时间戳标记不能直接显示顺序顺序序列或多角度同步抵消(App. A.3.1.

blocks.en: SYNCR rankings correlate with real-video scores. To test whether the synthetic benchmark tracks performance beyond its own items, we evaluate the same 17 standard open-weight checkpoints on MVU-Eval Temporal Reasoning and Comparison using the same harness. Their SYNCR averages correlate with both real-video scores (Spearman ρ = 0.86 \rho=0.86 and 0.92 0.92 , both p < 0.001 p<0.001 ); the correlations remain 0.78 0.78 and 0.87 0.87 after accounting for model size (App. B.3.2 ). This supports SYNCR’s relevance to real-video evaluation. A general video-understanding factor could also produce these correlations, so they do not establish that SYNCR isolates cross-video reasoning.
blocks.zh: SYNCR排名与真视频分数相关. 为了测试合成基准是否跟踪超出自身物品的性能,我们用同样的绳索对MVU-Eval Temperal Reasoning and Compressation上相同的17个标准的开放重量检查站进行评估. 其SYNCR平均值与真实录像的分数(Spearman ë = 0.86\rho = 0.86和 0.92 0.92,均p < 0.001 p < 0.001)相关;在计算模型大小后,相关数仍为0.78 0.78和0.87 0.87(App.B.3.2)。 这支持了SYNCR对真视频评价的相关性. 一个一般的视频理解因素也可以产生这些关联性,因此它们不能确定SYNCR隔离跨视频推理.

blocks.en: 4 Learning from Synthetic Supervision
blocks.zh: 4 学习合成监督

blocks.en: The same task generators used for diagnosis provide supervision. We test three increasingly demanding outcomes: improvement on held-out SYNCR videos, generalization to changed task structures and video sources, and transfer to real footage.
blocks.zh: 用于诊断的同一任务发电机提供监督。 我们测试了三种要求越来越高的结果:改进被搁置的SYNCR视频,概括到改变的任务结构和视频来源,以及转移到真实的镜头.

blocks.en: Figure 4: SYNCR accuracy after finetuning Qwen3-VL-8B. All bars use the same 200 held-out items per task. Each single-task SFT bar comes from a separate adapter trained on that task; eight-task SFT uses one adapter trained on all tasks. Eight-task RL applies GRPO to the base checkpoint, while SFT → \rightarrow RL applies it after eight-task SFT.
blocks.zh: 图4:微调Quen3-VL-8B后的SYNCR精度. 所有栏杆每个任务使用相同的200个被搁置的物品. 每个单任务SFT栏都来自一个经过该任务训练的单独适配器;八任务SFT使用一个经过所有任务训练的适配器. 八任务RL将GRPO应用到基地检查站,而SFT →\rightarrow RL则在八任务SFT之后应用.

blocks.en: Training setup. We train Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct for one epoch with rank-16 LoRA adapters ( Hu et al., 2022 ) and a frozen vision encoder (App. C.1 ). Eight single-task adapters each receive one task’s examples; an 8-task adapter receives all 15,960 training examples. We repeat the 8-task recipe on Qwen3-VL-4B and InternVL3.5-8B (App. C.2 ). We also test GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) with binary correctness rewards, initialized either from the base model or from 8-task SFT (App. C.2 ).
blocks.zh: 培训设置. 我们训练Quen3-VL-8B-指示器,用于一个具有16级LORA适配器(Hu等人,2022年)和冷冻视觉编码器(App. C.1. 8个单任务适配器各获得1个任务的实例;8个任务适配器获得全部15,960个培训实例. 我们重复关于Qune3-VL-4B和InternVL3.5-8B的8任务配方(App.C.2 )。 我们还通过二进制正确性奖励对GRPO(Shao等人,2024年)进行测试,从基模或8任务SFT(App. C.2.

blocks.en: 4.1 Training Gains on SYNCR
blocks.zh: 4.1 关于SYNCR的培训成果

blocks.en: Supervision improves seven of eight tasks. On the same first 200 held-out items per task for base and trained models, Qwen3-VL-8B rises from 32.6% to 61.6% average accuracy after 8-task SFT (Fig. 4 ). It reaches 98% on Sequential Ordering, 75% on Kinematic Comparison, 73% on Object Re-identification, and 70% on Multi-Angle Synchronization. Seven task gains survive correction for multiple comparisons (App. C.4.5 ). Object Counting is the exception: it changes from 30.5% to 34.5%, a smaller gain than on the other tasks. Removing the answer options reveals better relative count estimates despite weak exact accuracy (App. C.3 ).
blocks.zh: 监督改进了八项任务中的七项。 在对基本型型和经过培训的型号进行相同的前200项任务中,Qune3-VL-8B在SFT(图4)8任务后的平均准确度从32.6%上升到61.6%。 它在顺序排序上达到98%,在Kinematics比较上达到75%,在对象重新识别上达到73%,在多角度同步上达到70%. 为了进行多重比较,有7项任务收益得以纠正(App.C.4.5)。 对象计数是例外:它从30.5%变为34.5%,比其他任务的收益要小. 删除答案选项显示,尽管准确性差,但相对计数估计数却更好(App.C.3)。

blocks.en:
Synchronization is higher with multi-task SFT. Multi-Angle Synchronization reaches 70.0% with eight tasks and 69.5–78.0% in other mixes that include it, versus 37.0% with Multi-Angle Synchronization-only SFT; larger training sets preclude attributing the difference to task combination alone.
The 8-task recipe raises InternVL3.5-8B from 29.3% to 62.8% on matched items. Qwen3-VL-4B reaches 62.6% on the first 200 items per task, but its available base score uses all 500, so a matched gain is unavailable (App. C.2 ).
blocks.zh:
多任务SFT同步率较高. 多角同步达到70.0%,完成8项任务,在包含它的其他组合中达到69.5–78.0%,而只有多角同步的SFT则达到37.0%;大型的训练集排除了将差异归因于任务组合本身.
8任务配方将相应项目上的InternVL3.5-8B从29.3%提高到62.8%. Qwen3-VL-4B在每次任务前200项上达到62.6%,但其可用的基分使用全部500,因此没有相应的收益(App. C.2.

blocks.en: The tested GRPO recipe yields smaller gains. Eight-task GRPO from the base improves the mean by 2.5 points, or 4.2 with a second seed, versus 28.9 points for 8-task SFT. Single-task GRPO raises Kinematic Comparison from 21.0% to 48.5%, still below the corresponding SFT adapter’s 73.5% (App. C.2 ). Starting GRPO from 8-task SFT reaches 62.5%, 0.9 points above SFT alone. This comparison concerns the tested binary-reward GRPO configuration, not RL methods in general.
blocks.zh: 已测试的GPRO配方收益较小。 基地八任务GRPO提高平均分2.5分,或4.2分加第二个种子,而八任务SFT则获得28.9分. 单任务GRPO将Kinematic比较率从21.0%提高到48.5%,仍低于相应的SFT适配器的73.5%(App. C.2). 从8任务SFT开始GRPO达到62.5%,仅SFT就高出0.9分. 这种比较涉及测试过的二进制-奖励GRPO配置,而不是一般的RL方法.

blocks.en: 4.2 Generalization to New Structures and Video Sources
blocks.zh: 4.2 对新结构和视频来源的概括

blocks.en: Table 2: Generalization to shifted task configurations. Accuracy (%) of the base and eight-task SFT Qwen3-VL-8B. “Standard” uses the first 200 benchmark items; “New” uses a separate 200-item set. (a) Changes the number of segments, videos, or queried categories, or uses a held-out camera rig for Sync . (b) Tests a task on a simulator absent from that task’s training examples (C: CLEVRER; K: Kubric; H: Habitat).
blocks.zh: 表2:向任务配置转变的一般化。 基础精度(%)和八任务SFT Quen3-VL-8B. “标准”使用前200项基准项目;“新”使用单独的200项。 (a) 改变片段、视频或被询问类别的数目,或使用Sync的挂载照相机。 (b) 测试该任务培训实例中没有的模拟器(C:CLEVRER;K:Kubric;H:生境)。

blocks.en: We evaluate fixed 200-item sets with either a changed task structure or a new video source for that task (Table 2 ; App. C.5 ). Structural shifts change the number of segments, videos, or queried categories while retaining the simulator and question format. A separate Multi-Angle Synchronization shift uses a held-out camera rig with altered positions and focal lengths. Source swaps keep the task format but use an engine absent from that task’s training examples.
blocks.zh: 我们评价固定的200个项目,其任务结构有改变,也有新的录像来源(表2;App.C.5)。 结构变换会改变片段,视频的数量,或者询问类别,同时保留模拟和提问格式. 单独的多角度同步变换使用一个带有变换位置和焦距的悬浮相机钻机. 源交换保留了任务格式,但使用了该任务培训实例中没有的引擎。

blocks.en: Gains persist under structural and camera-rig shifts. With three or five segments instead of four, trained Sequential Ordering accuracy reaches 99.0–99.5%. With three videos instead of two, Kinematic Comparison rises from 12.5% to 91.0% and Numerical Comparison from 23.5% to 45.5%. Two-video Multi-Angle Synchronization rises from 26.5% to 56.0%; on the held-out camera rig it reaches 74.5% versus 23.0% for the base. Object Counting shows a smaller change on the four-category shift.
blocks.zh: 结构性和相机式的转变继续带来收益。 通过三、五个段而不是四个段,经过培训的顺序排列精度达到99.0-99.5%。 有了三段视频而不是两段,Kinematic比较率从12.5%上升到91.0%,数字比较率从23.5%上升到45.5%。 双视多镜同步率从26.5%上升到56.0%;在停机相机平台上,比基座的23.0%达到74.5%。 对象计数显示四类移位变化较小.

blocks.en: Transfer to held-out task–simulator pairings varies. Ordering improves from 35.5% to 95.5% on Kubric, but more modestly on Habitat walkthroughs (41.5% to 50.5%) and route clips (55.5% to 71.0%). InternVL3.5-8B likewise rises from 55.0% to 100.0% on Kubric ordering (App. C.5 ). Object Counting improves on Kubric shape counting (24.5% to 40.0%) and CLEVRER material–shape counting (49.0% to 58.0%), but changes little on CLEVRER shape counting.
blocks.zh: 传输到 hold- out 任务 - 模拟配对方式不同 。 库布里奇的订购率从35.5%提高到95.5%,但生境走行部(41.5%提高到50.5%)和路线剪辑率(55.5%提高到71.0%)则略有改善。 根据Kubric订购,实习生VL3.5-8B的比例也从55.0%上升到100.0%(App.C.5)。 对象计数在库布里克形状计数(24.5%至40.0%)和CLEVRER材料 — — 形状计数(49.0%至58.0%)上有所改进,但CLEVRER形状计数上变化不大。

blocks.en: 4.3 Sim-to-Real Transfer
blocks.zh: 4.3 向实际转移

blocks.en: Ordering gains transfer to real footage. We apply SYNCR’s Sequential Ordering format to Assembly101 ( Sener et al., 2022 ) and CMU Panoptic ( Joo et al., 2015 ) . Each fixed, answer-balanced set has 200 items formed by shuffling four gapped segments from a 20-second window; chronology supplies the label. Assembly101 uses static recordings and Panoptic individual camera streams, retaining within-stream ordering across new visual domains (App. C.6.1 ). Eight-task SFT improves Qwen3-VL-8B by 9.0 and 19.0 points on the two sets, InternVL3.5-8B by 14.0 and 20.5, and Qwen3-VL-4B by 19.0 and 16.5 (Fig. 5 ). All six gains have paired McNemar p ≤ 0.015 p\leq 0.015 ; the corrected Panoptic Qwen3-VL-8B result uses a conservative bound. Item-level intervals do not account for repeated windows from one recording (App. C.6.1 ).
blocks.zh: 命令收益转移到真实的镜头。 我们对Assembly101(Sener等人,2022年)和CMU Panoptic(Joo等人,2015年)采用SYNCR的顺序排序格式。 每个固定的,答案平衡的集有200个项,通过从20秒窗口打出4个空隙段来形成;编年史提供标签. Assembly101使用静态录音和光学单个相机流,保留跨新视觉域的流程内订购(App. C.6.1 . 八任务SFT在两套上改进了Quen3-VL-8B的9.0分和19.0分,InternVL3.5-8B的14.0分和20.5分,Quen3-VL-4B的19.0分和16.5分(图5). 所有6种增益都与McNemar p 0.015 p\leq 0.015对齐;经过修正的Panoptic Quen3-VL-8B结果使用保守约束. 项目级别间隔不计入一次录音的重复窗口(App.C.6.1)。

blocks.en: Cross-camera counting transfer remains uncertain. On a nuScenes ( Caesar et al., 2020 ) set asking for distinct objects across six surround cameras, every checkpoint scores higher with six views than with one. The six-versus-one gap rises from 7.8 to 17.3 points for the first Qwen3-VL-8B SFT seed, but an increased gap is not established for its other seeds or InternVL3.5-8B. Additional views may expose more objects without improving cross-camera deduplication; absolute accuracy remains low (App. C.6.1 ).
blocks.zh: 跨镜头计数转移仍然不确定。 Caesar等人(Kaesar等人,2020年)在一张nuScenes上, 六比一差距在首个Quen3-VL-8B SFT种子中从7.8分升至17.3分,但其其他种子或InternVL3.5-8B的差距并未扩大. 其他观点可能会在不改进交叉相机分解的情况下暴露更多的物体;绝对准确度仍然很低(App. C.6.1 )。

blocks.en:
Transfer on existing benchmarks. On MVU-Eval ( Peng et al., 2025 ) Temporal Reasoning and CrossVid ( Li et al., 2026 ) Procedural Step Sequencing, 8-task SFT gains 7.5 and 10.0 points for Qwen3-VL-8B, and 16.5 and 28.0 for InternVL3.5-8B, each relative to its own base. The Qwen gains persist when the same CrossVid items are answered in letter-string or prose formats absent from SYNCR training ( + 19.0 +19.0 and + 8.0 +8.0 points; App. C.6.2 ).
On VSI-Bench ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , appearance order improves from 54.0% to 68.5% for Qwen3-VL-8B and from 46.0% to 52.0% for InternVL3.5-8B; route planning also rises in both families. These are independently defined single-video questions, so the appearance-order result tests transfer beyond both SYNCR’s construction and the cross-video setting, rather than demonstrating cross-camera alignment.
blocks.zh:
在现有基准基础上转让。 在MVU-Eval上(Peng等人,2025年) 时间理性与交叉维德(Li等人,2026年) 程序 Step Sequencing,8-任务 SFT 增益7.5分和10.0分的Qwen3-VL-8B,以及16.5分和28.0分的InternVL3.5-8B,各自相对自己的基数. 如果在SYNCR训练中没有用字母串或发音格式回答相同的交叉维德项目(+19.0+19.0和+8.0+8.0分;App.C.6.2),则Quen收益持续存在.
在VSI-Bench(Yang等人,2025年)上,Qune3-VL-8B的外观定型从54.0%提高到68.5%,InternVL3.5-8B的外观定型从46.0%提高到52.0%;两家的路线规划也都有所提高. 这些是独立定义的单视频问题,因此外观顺序结果测试转移超越了SYNCR的构造和跨视频设置,而不是显示跨镜头对齐.

Blue indicates a gain and red a loss. Panel (a) uses SYNCR-format questions on real footage, while panel (b) shows individual tasks from existing benchmarks. Table 19 gives the absolute scores and item counts behind every cell.
blocks.zh: 图5:8任务SYNCR SFT之后的真视频结果. 每个单元格显示该模型在相同项目上的准确度变化,以百分比计。 蓝色表示增益,红色表示损失。 小组(a)在真实镜头中使用SYNCR格式问题,而小组(b)从现有基准中显示各项任务。 表19列出每个单元格后面的绝对分数和项目数。

blocks.en: 4.4 Controls and Robustness Checks
blocks.zh: 4.4 控制和健全检查

blocks.en: Incorrect-label supervision does not reproduce the gains. A placebo adapter trained on the same examples, inputs, and options with random wrong labels scores below base on every SYNCR task and loses 7.5–35.0 points on five real-benchmark tasks. On MVU-Eval Temporal Reasoning, it scores 43.0% versus 68.0% for base and 75.5% for correct SFT. This supports the role of correct labels; alternative answer formats are tested separately (Apps. C.4.2 and C.6.2 ).
blocks.zh: 不正确的标签监督不会复制收益。 一个安慰剂适配器接受了相同的实例,输入,和选项的训练,在每次SYNCR任务上随机错误的标签得分低于基数,在五个真实基准任务上损失7.5–35.0分. 在MVU-Eval Timoral Reasoning上,基数的得分为43.0%对68.0%,正确SFT的得分为75.5%. 这支持正确标签的作用;另类答案格式分别测试(Apps.C.4.2和C.6.2).

blocks.en: The tested spatial baseline does not reproduce temporal transfer. A matched-budget SAT ( Ray et al., 2024 ) arm, with frames rendered as clips, lowers MVU-Eval Temporal Reasoning and CrossVid Procedural Step Sequencing by 8.5 and 17.0 points. This result concerns that alternative under our format (App. C.4.1 ).
blocks.zh: 经测试的空间基线不会复制时间转移. 匹配预算的SAT臂(Ray等人,2024年),帧作为剪辑,将MVU-Eval Temperal Reasoning和CrossVid程序步骤排序降低8.5和17.0分. 这一结果涉及我们格式下的这一备选办法(App. C.4.1)。

blocks.en: Training gains are larger with video input. Removing videos leaves 8-task SFT near chance on seven tasks; Route Planning is the exception at 39.5%. The mean gain is 28.9 points with videos, and the full-video versus no-video gain contrast is 27.1 points. This contrast depends on video availability under the ablation but does not isolate a causal visual contribution (App. C.4.4 ).
blocks.zh: 随着视频投入,培训成果更大。 删除视频让8任务SFT在7项任务上几乎有机会;路线规划是39.5%的例外. 平均收益与视频的比分为28.9分,全视频与无视频的比分为27.1分. 这种对比取决于在衰减下视频的可用性,但并不孤立因果视觉贡献(App.C.4.4).

blocks.en: Main gains persist across seeds and multiple-testing correction. Three 8-task SFT seeds average 61.6%, 61.8%, and 64.6% on SYNCR (task-level SD at most 5.1 points). A second seed gains 10.0 and 18.5 points on Assembly101 and Panoptic ordering, versus 9.0 and 19.0 for the first (App. C.4.3 ). Seven of eight SYNCR gains and both existing temporal-benchmark gains survive Benjamini–Hochberg correction (App. C.4.5 ).
blocks.zh: 种子和多次试验纠正的主要成果依然存在。 三颗8任务SFT种子平均为61.6%,61.8%,在SYNCR上为64.6%(任务级SD最高为5.1分). 第二个种子在Assembly101和Panoptic订购上获得10.0和18.5分,而第一个种子获得9.0和19.0分(App.C.4.3.)。 8项SYNCR收益中的7项和现有的时间基准收益都幸存在Benjamini-Hochberg校正(App.C.4.5.)。

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: Multi-video evaluation. CVBench ( Zhu et al., 2025b ) , MVU-Eval ( Peng et al., 2025 ) , CrossVid ( Li et al., 2026 ) and MVPBench ( Bai et al., 2026 ) extend single-video evaluation ( Fu et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024b ) to questions that relate evidence across videos, and GameplayQA ( Wang et al., 2026 ) does so for synchronized agent viewpoints in virtual environments. Adjacent lines of work relate observations without a cross-video question format: static multi-view understanding ( Yeh et al., 2026 ) , egocentric–exocentric activity ( Grauman et al., 2024 ) and video-based spatial memory ( Yang et al., 2025 ) . Several benchmarks also check dependence on visual input (Table 3 ). SYNCR’s distinction is to couple simulator-state labels and shared generators with matched training data, evidence controls, and tests of transfer.
blocks.zh: 多视频评价. CV Bench(Zhu等人,2025年b),MVU-Eval(Peng等人,2025年),Cross Vid(Li等人,2026年)和MVPBench(Bai等人,2026年)将单视频评价(Fu等人,2025年;Zhou等人,2024年;Li等人,2024年b)扩展至跨视频相关证据的问题,GameplayQA(Wang等人,2026年)则在虚拟环境下同步代理观点. 相邻的工作线与观测有关,没有跨视频问题格式:静态多视图理解(Yeh等人,2026年),自我中心-异心活动(Grauman等人,2024年)和基于视频的空间记忆(Yang等人,2025年)。 一些基准还检查对视觉输入的依赖(表3)。 SYNCR的区别在于配对模拟器状态标签和共享发电机,并配有匹配的训练数据、证据控制和转移测试。

blocks.en: Learning from simulated video data. Simulation already supplies supervision for single-video skills: Chain-of-Frames ( Ghazanfari et al., 2025 ) trains frame-grounded reasoning on CLEVRER, SAT ( Ray et al., 2024 ) and SIMS-V ( Brown et al., 2025 ) train on spatial questions, and ST-VLM ( Ko et al., 2025 ) on kinematics, building on simulation-to-real transfer ( Tobin et al., 2017 ) . None of it supervises relating evidence across separate streams. In our matched-example comparison, SAT frames rendered as clips did not reproduce SYNCR’s temporal-transfer gains; this result concerns one alternative dataset and training recipe. SYNCR trains on simulated data for cross-video reasoning, and couples that supervision with controls, establishing a framework in which a capability can be diagnosed, taught, and its transfer to real video measured under one set of task definitions.
blocks.zh: 学习模拟视频数据. 模拟已经为单视频技能提供监督: Frames链(Ghazanfari等人,2025年) 列车在CLEVRER,SAT(Ray等人,2024年)和SIMS-V(Brown等人,2025年)的空间问题列车和ST-VLM(Ko等人,2025年)的动因学列车,在模拟-实际转移的基础上发展(Tobin等人,2017年). 它没有监督不同流的关联证据。 在我们的匹配比较中,作为剪辑提供的SAT帧没有复制SYNCR的时间传输收益;这一结果涉及一个替代数据集和培训方法。 SYNCR列车在模拟数据上进行跨视频推理,以及使用控制进行监管的伴侣,建立了一个框架,在这个框架内可以诊断、教授一种能力,并将其转移到一套任务定义下测量的真实视频。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: SYNCR connects simulator-grounded evaluation with targeted supervision across eight cross-video reasoning tasks. Across 22 models, performance is uneven, with persistent difficulties in physical comparison and scene integration. On matched 200-item sets per task, eight-task SFT raises Qwen3-VL-8B’s mean accuracy from 32.6% to 61.6%, and several gains persist when task structure or video source changes. On real footage, the clearest replicated transfer is chronological ordering: three checkpoints gain 9.0–20.5 points on the constructed Assembly101 and Panoptic sets, with improvements also on existing temporal benchmarks. The results identify a skill that transfers from synthetic supervision while showing that transfer varies substantially by task.
blocks.zh: SYNCR将模拟基于的评价与8项跨视频推理任务的定向监督联系起来. 在22个模型中,性能参差不齐,在物理比较和场景整合方面始终存在困难. 在匹配每个任务的200个项目集上,八项任务SFT将Qune3-VL-8B的平均精度从32.6%提高到61.6%,当任务结构或视频源变化时,一些收益依然存在。 在真实的镜头中,最明显的复制转移是按时间顺序进行:三个检查站在已建造的Assembly101和Panoptic套装上获得9.0-20.5分,同时在现有时间基准方面也有改进。 结果确定了一种技能,即从合成监督中转移,同时表明转移因任务而有很大差异。

blocks.en: Limitations. SYNCR uses visual-only multiple-choice questions, mostly from simulation; simulator labels do not guarantee that every answer is visible in RGB. Real-footage ordering uses clips from one source stream, and item-level intervals ignore repeated recordings. Transfer on other real-footage tasks remains uncertain. RL findings concern the tested GRPO settings.
blocks.zh: 限制。 SYNCR使用只可视的多选择问题,大多来自模拟;模拟器标签并不能保证每个答案在RGB中都可见. Real-footage订购使用一个源流的剪辑,项目级别间隔忽略了重复的录音. 移交其他实足任务的工作仍不确定。 RL调查结果涉及经过测试的GRPO设置.

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: SYNCR benchmark videos are simulator-rendered: Habitat traverses HM3D scans of real indoor spaces ( Ramakrishnan et al., 2021 ) , whereas Kubric and CLEVRER depict generated object scenes. Transfer evaluations use existing real-footage datasets; we did not collect new footage for them. The human baseline study (App. B.2 ) involved four graduate-student volunteers who answered multiple-choice questions about benchmark videos; it did not collect personal, sensitive, demographic, or behavioral information beyond the selected answer choices. We do not anticipate direct harms from this benchmark; as with other video-understanding evaluations, downstream systems trained or evaluated on it should still be assessed for fairness and safety before deployment.
blocks.zh: SYNCR基准视频为模拟器-上传:栖息地穿越HM3D扫描真实室内空间(Ramakrishnan等人,2021年),而库布里克和CLEVRER则描绘生成物体场景. 传输评价使用现有的实时数据集;我们没有为它们收集新的镜头。 人类基线研究(App.B.2)涉及四名研究生志愿者,他们回答了关于基准视频的多重选择问题;它没有收集超出选定答案选择的个人、敏感、人口或行为信息。 我们预计这一基准不会产生直接损害;与其他视频理解评价一样,在部署之前仍应对对其进行培训或评价的下游系统进行公平和安全评估。

blocks.en: A.1 Dataset Generation Details
blocks.zh: A.1 数据集生成细节

blocks.en: This subsection documents how each engine supplies input videos and annotations for programmatic question construction. We describe rendering, visibility filtering, answer computation, and distractor generation, with the exact task prompts shown below.
blocks.zh: 本小节记录了每个引擎如何为方案问题构建提供输入视频和说明. 我们描述渲染,能见度过滤,回答计算,以及分散器生成,具体的任务提示如下.

blocks.en: A.1.1 Habitat
blocks.zh: A.1.1 生境

blocks.en: Habitat ( Savva et al., 2019 ) with HM3D ( Ramakrishnan et al., 2021 ) provides egocentric RGB observations, semantic instance annotations, and navigation meshes for large indoor environments. We use the 216 HM3D scenes with dense semantic annotations (Fig. 6 ).
blocks.zh: 栖息地(Savva等人,2019年)与HM3D(Ramakrishnan等人,2021年)提供以自我为中心的RGB观测,语义实例说明,以及大型室内环境的导航网格. 我们使用216 HM3D的场景,带有密集的语义说明(图6).

blocks.en: Figure 6: Deterministic Ground Truth Generation in Habitat. Habitat provides synchronized RGB, depth, and semantic observations for each rendered camera pose, from which SYNCR derives visibility, instance labels, and navigation structure.
blocks.zh: 图6:生境中确定性的地面真相生成。 生境提供同步的RGB、深度和语义观测,以观察每个相机的姿势,SYNCR从中获得可见度、实例标签和导航结构。

blocks.en: Scene loading. We load each HM3D scene’s textured mesh, semantic annotations, and navigation mesh. Semantic annotations map instance IDs to normalized object names; the navigation mesh supports pathfinding and geodesic distances. We save RGB videos as MP4 files and semantic frame tensors separately. Only RGB is supplied to models; semantic tensors determine labels and filters. Scenes lacking semantic annotations or navigation meshes are skipped.
blocks.zh: 场景加载。 HM3D场景的文字网格、语义说明和导航网格都装满了。 语义说明 映射实例 ID 使对象名称正常化; 导航网支持路径查找和大地测量距离 。 我们分别将 RGB 视频保存为 MP4 文件 和 语义框架 的 百度 。 仅向模型提供RGB;语义变位器决定标签和过滤器. 缺少语义说明或导航网格的场景被跳过.

blocks.en: Trajectories. Habitat’s pathfinder returns a sparse shortest path for each sampled start–target pair. We remove duplicate waypoints, fit a cubic spline ( Virtanen et al., 2020 ) , and snap interpolated points to the navigation mesh. Camera yaw follows a fixed look-ahead window to reduce jitter. Videos contain 100 frames at 5 FPS and end with a panoramic sweep. Geodesic sampling exposes spatially separated regions for Object Re-identification and Object Counting; topological routing samples connected paths and slices them into clips with continuous endpoints for Route Planning.
blocks.zh: 轨迹. 栖息地的路径探测器为每个样本的起始对目标返回一条最短的路径。 我们去除重复的路标,装入一个立方形的线条(Virtanen等人,2020年),并断断向导航网点的插值。 摄影机yaw跟随固定的外观前方窗口,以减少焦躁. 视频在5 FPS中包含100帧,以全景扫瞄结束. 大地测量取样暴露了空间上分离的区域,用于物体重新识别和物体计数;地形路线取样连接了路径,并将其切成有连续终点的剪辑,用于路由规划。

blocks.en: Object Re-identification . Each item contains a reference and a target video. Semantic tensors identify shared instances and their contiguous visibility windows. We retain objects visible for at least five consecutive frames, with sufficient total visibility across at least two views. The answer is the first contiguous window containing that instance in the target video. Distractors use answer windows from other items with similar reference windows and lie within the 20-second video, reducing cues from option position and timing (Fig. 7 ).
blocks.zh: 对象重新识别 。 每个项目都包含一个参考和目标视频. 语义式的辨识器可以识别共享实例及其毗连的可见度窗口. 我们保留至少连续五个帧可见的物体,至少有两个视图的可见度。 答案是第一个在目标视频中包含这个实例的毗连窗口. 干扰器使用来自具有类似参考窗口的其他项目的解答窗口,并位于20秒的视频中,减少了选项位置和时间的提示(图7 )。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Habitat Object Re-identification prompt template. The model is given two Habitat videos and must identify the first timestamp window in Video 2 where the same semantic instance appears.
blocks.zh: 图7:生境对象重新识别快速模板。 该模型获得两个人居视频,必须识别视频2中出现同一语义实例的第一个时间戳窗口。

blocks.en: Object Counting . Each item contains three videos and asks for the number of distinct instances of two or three named categories. We compute totals from the union of semantic instance IDs across trajectories. Each counted instance must occupy at least 5% of a frame in at least one video. We discard items with only one available video and categories with more than 10 instances. To reduce small-count priors, we retain totals of at least k + 3 k{+}3 for k k categories and balance answers across totals. Options are four distinct values between k k and the answer plus four. We balance the answer’s offset from the categories’ typical total; audited text-only rules, including the smallest option and the value nearest that typical total, reach at most 32% on 500 items (Fig. 8 ).
blocks.zh: 对象计数. 每件物品包含三个视频,并询问两个或三个命名类别的明显实例的数目。 我们从语义学实例 ID的结合中计算出总数 每个计数实例必须至少占据至少一个视频中帧的5%. 我们丢弃只有一个视频的物项和10个以上实例的类别。 为了减少小数前科,我们保留了至少k + 3 k + 3 k → k 类的总数,并在总数中平衡答案. 选项是 k 和 答案加 4 之间的四个不同的值。 我们平衡了这些类别的典型总数中的答案;经过审计的文本规则,包括最小的选项和最接近的典型总数,在500个项目(图8)上最多达到32%。

blocks.en: Figure 8: Habitat Object Counting prompt template. The model must aggregate observations across multiple Habitat videos and count unique semantic instances of two or three named categories.
blocks.zh: 图8:生境对象计数快速模板。 该模型必须汇总对多个人居视频的观察,并计算出两个或三个指定类别的独特语义实例。

blocks.en: Route Planning . Each item contains three clips of a route. We concatenate their route chunks, remove duplicated boundary nodes, and discard routes with fewer than three nodes. Questions use subpaths close to the full route length to encourage integration across clips; the answer is the shortest subpath between the designated regions. We describe each room by its three rarest objects, excluding background and structural terms. Distractors use rooms observed in the input videos and match the answer hop-count distribution, with answers split evenly between two and three or more hops. Distractors exclude direct start-to-goal paths and paths revisiting either endpoint, reducing obvious shortest-path cues (Fig. 9 ).
blocks.zh: 路线规划. 每件物品包含一个路线的三个片段. 我们把他们的路线块,去掉重复的边界节点, 丢弃不到三个节点的路线。 问题使用接近全路线长度的子路径来鼓励跨剪辑集成;答案是指定区域之间最短的子路径. 我们用三个稀有物体来描述每个房间,不包括背景和结构术语。 干扰者使用输入视频中观察到的房间,并匹配解答hop计数分布,解答在2到3或更多hop之间均匀分布. 注意力分散者排除了直接开始到目标路径和重新审视任一终点的路径,从而减少了明显的最短路径提示(图9)。

blocks.en: Figure 9: Habitat Route Planning prompt template. The model must infer the shortest navigable path between two regions by integrating partial spatial observations across multiple Habitat videos.
blocks.zh: 图9:生境路线 规划即时模板. 该模型必须综合跨越多个人居视频的部分空间观测,推断出两个区域之间最短的可航行路径。

blocks.en: A.1.2 Kubric
blocks.zh: A.1.2 库布里奇

blocks.en: Simulation. Kubric ( Greff et al., 2022 ) renders dynamic object interactions with known camera parameters, object visibility, and 3D state. We simulate 10–15 objects in a 10 × 10 10\times 10 region with PyBullet ( Coumans & Bai, 2016–2021 ) and render them with Blender’s Cycles engine ( Blender Online Community, 2018 ) at 256 × 256 256\times 256 pixels, for 5 s at 12 FPS (60 frames). The dataset is evenly split across two shape vocabularies: 1,000 scenes use the standard CLEVR shapes (cube, cylinder, sphere), and the remaining 1,000 use an expanded KuBasic suite of 11 primitives (including tori, gears, and teapots). To sustain motion, the floor is frictionless with a restitution of 0.5, and objects start with planar velocities sampled uniformly from − 4.0 -4.0 to 4.0 4.0 units per second along the X and Y axes and zero vertical velocity.
blocks.zh: 模拟. Kubric(Greff等人,2022年)使动态对象与已知的相机参数,对象可见度,和3D状态发生相互作用. 我们用 PyBullet (Coumans & Bai, 2016–2021) 来模拟 10–15 个物体, 用 Blender 的循环引擎(Blender Online Community, 2018) 用 256x 256\times 256 像素, 为 5 s , 以 12 FPS (60 帧) 做成 。 数据集均匀地分为两个形状词汇:1000场景使用标准的CLEVR形状(立方体,圆柱体,球体),其余1000场则使用11个原始人(包括托里,齿轮,和茶壶)的扩大的KuBasic套件. 为了维持运动,地板是无摩擦的,还原率为0.5,物体以平面速度为起点,沿X轴和Y轴从−4.0-4.0至4.04.0单位每秒统一取样,垂直速度为0。

blocks.en: Camera rig. A synchronized three-camera rig with a 35mm focal length gives distinct, partially overlapping views: • Camera 0 (Right): Positioned at base coordinates (7.48, -6.50, 5.34) and angled to look at (4, 0, 0). • Camera 1 (Left): Positioned on the opposite side of the scene at (-7.48, 6.50, 5.34) and angled to look at (-4, 0, 0). • Camera 2 (Front-Center): Positioned lower and further back at (0.0, -13.5, 5.0), directly observing the origin (0, 0, 0). We add a small uniform random offset to each camera’s base position per scene to vary the extrinsics. Visibility matrices, 2D segmentation masks, and bounding boxes are recomputed per camera view, since they depend on the viewpoint. Object identities are aligned across views through shared asset identifiers, and object names are generated from their size, color, material, and shape.
blocks.zh: 摄影机 装有35毫米焦距的同步三摄像头钻机可提供不同、部分重叠的视角: 相机0(右):定位在基座坐标(7.48, -650, 5.34),仰角为4,0,0。 • 第1摄影机(左):位于(7.48、6.50、5.34)现场对面,角度为(4、0、0) • 相机2(前沿中心): 下方和后方的位置为(0.0、-13.5、5.0),直接观测原产地(0、0、0)。 我们为每个场景的基部位置增加一个小的制服随机抵消, 可见度矩阵,2D分割口罩,以及边框每个相机视图重算,因为它们取决于视角. 对象身份通过共享资产识别符在视图之间对齐,对象名称根据其大小、颜色、材料和形状生成。

blocks.en: Camera 0 (Right): Positioned at base coordinates (7.48, -6.50, 5.34) and angled to look at (4, 0, 0).
Camera 1 (Left): Positioned on the opposite side of the scene at (-7.48, 6.50, 5.34) and angled to look at (-4, 0, 0).
Camera 2 (Front-Center): Positioned lower and further back at (0.0, -13.5, 5.0), directly observing the origin (0, 0, 0).
blocks.zh: 相机 2 (前线中心): 下方和后方的位置为(0.0、-13.5、5.0),直接观测原产地(0、0、0)。

blocks.en: Multi-Angle Synchronization . We independently sample three 3-second crops from a scene’s 5-second recording and randomly assign camera views to Videos 1–3. Videos 2 and 3 may start before or after Video 1; their relative crop-start times determine the answer. Distractor offsets use independent repetitions of the crop sampling, matching the answer distribution without systematic sign-flip or swap relations (Fig. 10 ).
blocks.zh: 多角度同步 。 我们从一个场景的5秒录制中独立抽取了3秒的作物,并随机给1-3视频分配摄像头视图. 视频2和视频3可在视频1前后开始;其相对的作物启动时间决定答案. 灾难冲抵使用作物取样的独立重复,匹配答案分布,而无需系统性的标志-flip或互换关系(图10).

blocks.en: Figure 10: Kubric Multi-Angle Synchronization prompt template. The model is given three cropped videos of the same physical event from different camera angles and must infer their temporal offsets.
blocks.zh: 图10 库布里克多角度同步快速模板. 该模型从不同的相机角度获得三个相同物理事件的裁剪视频,必须推断它们的时间抵消.

blocks.en: Spatial Measurement . Each item contains two camera views and is anchored at the first frame where a designated event object leaves one view. We discard scenes with duplicate object names. At the event frame, the target must be visible in both views and the answer in at least one. The answer minimizes simulator-derived 3D distance among visible objects. Distractors match the distributions of size, shape, material, and color relations to the target. All distractors exist in the scene, and no visible distractor is closer than the answer (Fig. 11 ).
blocks.zh: 空间测量. 每个项目包含两个相机视图,并固定在指定事件对象离开一个视图的第一个框架. 我们丢弃重复对象名称的场景。 在事件框架中,目标必须同时在视图中可见,答案必须至少出现在一个. 答案将模拟器衍生的3D距离最小化于可见物体. 干扰器将大小,形状,材料,和颜色关系的分布与目标匹配. 场景中存在所有的分流器,没有明显的分流器比答案更接近(图11).

blocks.en: Figure 11: Kubric Spatial Measurement prompt template. The model is given two camera views and must identify which candidate object is closest to a target object in simulator-derived 3D space.
blocks.zh: 图11:库布里克空间测量快速模板. 该模型被赋予两个相机视图,必须识别哪个候选对象最接近模拟器衍生的3D空间中的目标对象.

blocks.en: A.1.3 CLEVRER
blocks.zh: A.1.3 克莱弗雷尔

blocks.en: CLEVRER ( Yi et al., 2019 ) provides simulated collision videos with frame-level annotations of object attributes, trajectories, velocities, visibility, and collision events. We reuse its original videos as model inputs and use the annotations only to construct and filter questions.
blocks.zh: CLEVRER(Ii 等人,2019年)提供模拟碰撞视频,其中包含对物体属性,轨迹,速度,能见度,以及碰撞事件的帧级别说明. 我们重新使用其原始视频作为模型输入,并且只使用说明来构建和过滤问题。

blocks.en: Sequential Ordering . We split each 128-frame, 25-FPS video into k = 4 k{=}4 equal-length segments separated by random gaps of 0.3–0.6 s, starting at a random offset, so that no two segments share a boundary frame. The clips are shuffled, and the answer is their chronological order. Every ordering is equally frequent as an answer, and distractor orderings are sampled in proportion to answer frequencies (Fig. 12 ).
blocks.zh: 顺序排列. 我们将每个128帧,25-FPS视频分成k=4k{=}4等长的片段,以0.3–0.6秒的随机空隙分隔,从随机抵消开始,这样两个片段就不会共享一个边界片段. 片段被洗刷,答案是他们的时间顺序. 每一个订单作为答案同样频繁,分心器订单按照响应频率的比例进行抽样(图12).

blocks.en: Figure 12: CLEVRER Sequential Ordering prompt template. The model is given shuffled temporal segments from one continuous CLEVRER event and must recover their original chronological order.
blocks.zh: 图12:CLEVRER序列 正在订购快速模板 。 该模型是从一个连续的CLEVRER事件中获得的洗涤时间段,必须恢复它们原来的时间顺序.

blocks.en: Kinematic Comparison . Each item has two videos. We compute each visible object’s instantaneous speed as the norm of its 3D velocity and keep only pairs in which both the cross-video maximum velocities and the within-video top-two velocities differ by at least τ = 0.25 \tau=0.25 . The options are the two fastest objects of each video, described by video index, color, material, and shape. Answer letters are balanced in the evaluation set; in the training set, video pairs are non-consecutive and each video is used at most twice (Fig. 13 ).
blocks.zh: 动因学比较. 每件东西都有两段录像。 我们计算每个可见物体的瞬间速度作为其3D速度的规范,并且只保留对数,在对数中,交叉视频最大速度和视频内最高二速度至少要=0.25\tau=0.25。 选项是每个视频的两个最快的对象,用视频索引,颜色,材料,和形状来描述. 答案字母在评价集中是平衡的;在培训集中,视频对联是非连续的,每个视频最多使用两次(图13.

blocks.en: Figure 13: CLEVRER Kinematic Comparison prompt template. The model must compare object motion across two CLEVRER videos and select the object with the simulator-derived highest peak velocity.
blocks.zh: 图13: CLEVRER Kinematic 比较快速模板. 该模型必须比较跨越两个CLEVRER视频的物体运动,并选择该物体与模拟器产生的最高峰速.

blocks.en: Numerical Comparison . We sample k k distinct videos, count their annotated collisions, and ask for the video with the most collisions and its difference from the second-highest count. Ties use the answer “most and second most have the same number of collisions – 0”, and non-tie distractors combine wrong video identities, nearby wrong differences, and a tie option. Each item has five options. Items are balanced across ties and differences of one, two, and three or more, with the winning video balanced; ties make up one fifth of the items, so always choosing the tie option scores chance (20%), and no video is shared between evaluation items (Fig. 14 ).
blocks.zh: 数字比较. 我们抽查KK的明显视频, 计算他们的注解碰撞, 并要求视频与碰撞最多 及其与第二高的计数的区别。 铁丝网使用答案“大多数和第二多的碰撞次数相同 — — 0”,非铁丝网分辨器结合了错误的视频身份,附近的错误差异,以及一个平局选项. 每个项目有五个选项。 项目在一、二、三、三的关联和差异之间是平衡的,胜出的视频是平衡的;关联占项目五分之一,因此总是选择平局选项得分(20%),评价项目之间没有分享视频(图14)。

blocks.en: Figure 14: CLEVRER Numerical Comparison prompt template. The model must compare collision counts across CLEVRER videos and identify both the video with the most collisions and the count difference.
blocks.zh: 图14: CLEVRER 数字比较快速模板. 该模型必须比较跨CLEVRER视频的碰撞计数,并识别视频与碰撞最多的和计数差异.

blocks.en: A.3 Benchmark Validity
blocks.zh: A.3 基准有效性

blocks.en: A.3.1 Preventing Temporal Metadata Leakage
blocks.zh: A.3.1 防止临时元数据泄漏

blocks.en: Gemini receives clips cut to the requested crop window before upload, without source-video crop timestamps in the prompt. Qwen3-VL’s per-frame timestamp markers are rebased so that each clip’s first sampled frame is at t = 0 t{=}0 . Markers retain elapsed time within a clip but do not reveal its absolute position in the source recording. This prevents source timestamps from revealing the chronological order in Sequential Ordering or the crop offsets in Multi-Angle Synchronization. Uncropped videos are unaffected. All reported evaluations use this protocol.
blocks.zh: 双子星在上传前会收到剪切到所请求的作物窗口的剪辑,在提示中没有源视频的作物时间戳. Qune3-VL的每帧时间戳标记重新定位,使每个片段的第一个采样帧在 t = 0 t = 0. 标记在剪辑中保留了过去的时间,但没有显示其在源录音中的绝对位置。 这使得源时间戳无法在顺序排序中显示时间顺序,或者在多角度同步中使裁剪抵消. 未剪辑的视频未受影响. 所有报告的评价都使用这项议定书。

blocks.en: Table 5: Video-dependence controls. Accuracy (%) with all videos, with one randomly selected video, and with no video; questions and options are unchanged.
blocks.zh: 表5:视频依赖控制。 准确度(%)与所有视频,一个随机选择的视频,没有视频;问题和选项不变.

blocks.en: A.3.2 No-Video and Single-Video Controls
blocks.zh: A.3.2 无影视和单影视控制

blocks.en: Distractors are sampled to avoid relations among the options that identify the answer without video (App. A.1 ). Answers are balanced over option letters and task-specific answer categories. On both the first 200 and all 500 evaluation items, no text-only rule we audited exceeds 33% accuracy on any task (chance is 25%, or 20% for Numerical Comparison).
blocks.zh: 对干扰物进行抽样,以避免在没有视频的情况下识别答案的选项之间的关系(App. A.1. 答案相对于选项字母和任务特定答案类别是平衡的. 在前200项和所有500项评价项目上,我们审计过的任何任务都没有任何文字规则超过33%的准确性(数字比较是25%,即20%)。

blocks.en: We remove the videos while keeping the question and options unchanged (Table 5 ). The no-video rows use the first 200 items for Qwen3-VL-8B, all 500 for Qwen3-VL-32B and the first 100 for GPT-6 Astra, which is asked to pick the most likely option; the 95% interval around chance is about ± \pm 6 points at 200 items, ± \pm 4 at 500 and ± \pm 8.5 at 100. No model exceeds that interval on any task, including on all 500 items for Qwen3-VL-8B, Qwen3-VL-32B and LLaVA-OneVision-72B. GPT-6 Astra falls marginally below it on Kinematic Comparison (16%), which reflects an attribute preference the items penalise rather than a text cue they supply.
blocks.zh: 我们删除这些录像, 无视频列使用前200项的Qwen3-VL-8B,全部500项的Qwen3-VL-32B和首100项的GPT-6 Astra,它们被要求选择最可能的选项;机会周围的95%间隔在200项上约为±\pm 6点, ±\pm 4在500, ±pm 8.5在100. 任何任务上,包括Qune3-VL-8B、Qune3-VL-32B和LLaVA-One Vision-72B的所有500件物品,都没有模型超过这一间隔。 GPT-6 Astra在Kinematic Compare(16%)上略低于它,

blocks.zh: 我们保留一个随机选择的视频,再次使问题和选项保持不变。 该控制器每任务使用前200项用于Quen型号,100项用于GPT-6 Astra. Quen3-VL-8B的顺序顺序从55.0%下降到24.0%,GPT-6的顺序顺序从100%下降到24%. 一项任务保留了高于常规的精度:Qwen3-VL-32B在Object Re-discription上达到39.5%,其中一台视频,所有视频为56.0%.

blocks.zh: 附录B 评价跨视频理由:额外细节

blocks.en: B.1 Experimental Details
blocks.zh: B.1 实验细节

blocks.en: Evaluation protocol. Each JSONL record stores the question, options, ground-truth answer, and ordered video list. Questions have four options, except Numerical Comparison, which has five. We preserve stored option order and prepend each visual input with its video index (Fig. 15 ). Records with start_sec and end_sec specify temporal crops; other records use the full video. Crop timestamps are handled as described in App. A.3.1 .
blocks.zh: 评估协议。 每张JSONL唱片存储问题,选项,地面真实答案,并订购视频列表. 问题有四个选择,除了数字比较,它有五个. 我们保存了存储的选项顺序,并用其视频索引(图15)预置每个视频输入。 有 start_sec和end_sec的记录指定了时间作物;其他记录则使用完整的视频. 作物时间戳按App所述处理。 A.3.1 (中文(简体) ).

blocks.en: We score the model’s final answer using the shared evaluation parser. When an answer marker is present, its final stated option is compared with the ground truth. Otherwise, the parser accepts an explicit option commitment, a single option-lettered answer line, or a response matching one option’s text. Unparsed responses are incorrect. This common scoring policy reduces penalties for answer-format deviations without treating an enumeration of options as a prediction.
blocks.zh: 我们使用共享评价解析器来评分模型的最终答案。 当一个答案标记存在时,其最后声明的选项与地面真相进行比较. 否则,解析器接受一个明确的选项承诺,一个单一的选项字母的答案行,或者一个匹配一个选项文本的响应. 未解析的答复是不正确的。 这种共同的评分政策减轻了对答案格式偏差的处罚,而不把列举选项作为预测.

blocks.en: Three tasks (Sequential Ordering, Kinematic Comparison, Numerical Comparison) re-use the original public CLEVRER videos, which may appear in some checkpoints’ pretraining data. The questions and options are newly generated, so this is not answer leakage, but visual familiarity with the rendering style could affect the zero-shot profile on those three tasks; the Habitat and Kubric videos are rendered for SYNCR and are not public.
blocks.zh: 三项任务(顺序排序,基内玛比较,数字比较)重新使用原有的公开的CLEVRER视频,这些视频可能出现在一些检查站的预训数据中. 问题和选项是新产生的,所以这不是回答渗漏,但对渲染风格的视觉熟悉会影响这三个任务上的零镜头配置;生境和库布里克视频是为SYNCR提供的,并不公开.

blocks.en: Statistical uncertainty. We report item-sampling uncertainty using 95% Wilson score intervals ( Wilson, 1927 ) (Table 7 ). At chance, interval half-widths are approximately 3.8 points for 500 items and 6.0 points for 200. Paired model comparisons use the exact two-sided McNemar test ( McNemar, 1947 ) on discordant items, including trained models against their own bases. These intervals do not measure training-seed or API-generation variability. Reuse of videos and scenes across questions can also limit the effective independence of items.
blocks.zh: 统计不确定性。 我们用95%的威尔逊分数间隔(威尔逊,1927年)报告项目样本的不确定性(表7)。 偶然时,间隔半径为500项约3.8分,200项约6.0分. 派尔德模型比较使用精确的双侧麦克尼马尔测试(McNemar,1947年)对不和谐物品进行,包括训练有素的模型与自己的基地相对. 这些间隔并不测量培训种子或API生成的变异性. 重复使用跨题的视频和场景也会限制物品的有效独立性.

blocks.en: B.2 Human Baseline Details
blocks.zh: B.2 人类基线细节

blocks.en: Four graduate-student volunteers with machine-learning or computer-vision experience answered the first 100 items per task used for proprietary evaluation (800 items each), given only RGB videos, questions and options, with no simulator annotations, labels or generation metadata. We aggregate by majority vote, score two-way ties incorrect and weight tasks equally, giving the reported 89.5% average.
blocks.zh: 四名具有机器学习或计算机视觉经验的研究生志愿者回答每个专有评价任务前100项(每项800项),只给出RGB视频,问题和选项,没有模拟说明,标签或生成元数据. 我们通过多数选票汇总,得分双向关系不正确,重量任务相等,平均得分89.5%。

blocks.en: We report four-person majority-vote accuracy rather than individual human accuracy. Performance reaches 68.0% on Kinematic Comparison and 76.0% on Spatial Measurement, indicating that these tasks remain challenging under the viewing protocol. Although simulator annotations provide precise ground-truth labels, these results do not establish that every answer is recoverable from the supplied RGB inputs.
blocks.zh: 我们报告的是四人多数投票的准确性,而不是个人的准确性。 在Kinematic比较和空间测量方面,性能分别达到68.0%和76.0%,表明这些任务在观看协议下仍然具有挑战性. 虽然模拟说明提供了精确的地面真实标签,但这些结果并不能确定每个答案都可以从提供的RGB输入中恢复.

blocks.en: B.3.1 Reasoning-Specialized Checkpoints
blocks.zh: B.3.1 合理的专门检查站

blocks.en: Reasoning-specialized post-training has uneven task-level effects. We compare Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking with Instruct on the same 500 items per task (Fig. 17 ). On Sequential Ordering, Thinking reaches 76.6% against Instruct’s 56.4%; on Multi-Angle Synchronization, the scores are 23.8% and 29.6%, respectively. Temporal Alignment rises from 43.0% to 50.2% and the overall average from 34.1% to 34.4%, while Spatial Tracking falls from 40.1% to 35.5% and Comparative Reasoning from 23.4% to 21.8%. These descriptive differences do not isolate the effect of deliberation because the checkpoints differ in post-training.

blocks.en: B.3.2 Agreement with a Real-Video Benchmark
blocks.zh: B.3.2 与实景基准达成的协议

blocks.en: The controls in Sec. 3.3 are internal to SYNCR: they show that items depend on the intended visual evidence, not that a checkpoint scoring better on SYNCR is better at real multi-video reasoning. We test that against a criterion SYNCR never touches, evaluating the same seventeen standard open-weight checkpoints on MVU-Eval Temporal Reasoning and Comparison through the identical harness (Table 8 ). SYNCR’s ranking reproduces both benchmarks’ rankings ( ρ = 0.855 \rho=0.855 and 0.917 0.917 , both p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), and does so beyond what model size explains, since partialling on log 10 \log_{10} parameters leaves 0.779 0.779 and 0.870 0.870 . It is not carried by one family, as the seven Qwen checkpoints alone give 0.901 0.901 and 0.927 0.927 , nor by one checkpoint, as leave-one-out leaves ρ \rho within [ 0.817 , 0.901 ] [0.817,0.901] and [ 0.905 , 0.944 ] [0.905,0.944] ; three checkpoints score below the 25% chance level on MVU-Eval Comparison because they fail to emit a parseable option rather than because they reason worse, and excluding every below-chance row leaves 0.826 0.826 and 0.860 0.860 . A general video-understanding factor would produce the same pattern, so the result shows that SYNCR does not rank models differently from real footage rather than that it isolates cross-video reasoning; and the relationship is not task-specific.
blocks.zh: sec.3.3中的控制是SYNCR的内部:它们显示物品依赖于预期的视觉证据,而不是一个检查点在SYNCR上的评分更好的是真正的多视频推理. 我们用SYNCR的标准来检验这一点,通过同样的控制手段来评估MVU-Eval Timoral Reasoning and Commerce上的同样17个标准开放重量检查站(表8)。 SYNCR的排名重复了两个基准的排名( ^ 0. 855\rho = 0.855和 0.917 0.917, 两者都为 < 0.001 p < 0.001 > ) , 并且超出了模型大小的解释,因为部分使用log 10\log 10) 参数留下0.779 0.779和0.870 0.870。 单是7个Quen检查站就给0.901 0.901和0.927 0.927,也不给1个检查站给一个家庭带去,因为在[0.817,0.901] [0.817,0.901]和[0.905,0.944] [0.905,0.944] 之内,有1个出行休假的假期是总和;在MVU-Eval比较中,有3个检查站的得分低于25%的机会水平,因为它们没有放出一个可变的选择,而不是因为理由更糟糕,而且不包括每排不足的假期0.826,0.826和0.860,0.860。 一般的视频理解因子会产生相同的模式,因此结果显示SYNCR对模型的排位与真实的镜头没有不同,而是隔离了交叉视频推理;而这种关系并非任务特定.

blocks.en: C.1 Training Details
blocks.zh: C.1 培训细节

blocks.en: Data. All runs use the same SYNCR training set (Table 4 ): 2,000 examples per task, except 1,960 for Object Counting. Inputs come from the CLEVRER training split, Kubric scenes excluded from evaluation, and Habitat training scenes. SFT uses the task-specific evaluation sampling rates; GRPO uses the frame configuration below. Training mixes contain 7,960 (4-task), 8,000 (4-task-alt), 11,960 (6-task), and 15,960 (8-task) examples.

blocks.en: SFT. We fine-tune Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, and the additional bases of App. C.2 (InternVL3.5-8B and Qwen3-VL-4B) under the same recipe, with LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) (rank 16, α = 32 \alpha{=}32 , dropout 0.05) and a frozen vision encoder, for one epoch at a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 5 5{\times}10^{-5} with 3% warmup and an effective batch size of 8 (one example per GPU and four accumulation steps on each of two GPUs). Targets contain only the answer line.
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2017-07-21). SFT. 我们在同一食谱下微调Qwen3-VL-8B-指令以及App.C.2(InternVL3.5-8B和Qwen3-VL-4B)的附加基数,其中LORA(Hu等人,2022年)(排名16,α=32\alpha{=}32,辍学0.05)和一个冷冻的视觉编码器,用于一个学期,学习速度为5×10×5\5\Times}10^{-5},热量3%,有效批量尺寸为8(每个GPU一个例子,两个GPU各有四个累积步骤)。 目标只包含答案行.

blocks.en: RL. We use GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) with the same LoRA configuration, 8 rollouts per prompt, completions of up to 1,024 tokens, a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , and a KL coefficient of β = 0.02 \beta{=}0.02 . The reward is 1 when the parsed answer letter is correct and 0 otherwise. Prompts use 16 frames per video at the evaluation resolution. 4-task RL and 8-task RL train for 1,000 steps and the single-task runs for 500, with the Kinematic Comparison and Numerical Comparison pilots run longer (Table 10 ). SFT → \rightarrow RL starts from the merged 8-task SFT models.

blocks.zh: 图18 单任务SFT的传输矩阵. 在列任务训练后,在列任务(每列200项)上评价的Qwen3-VL-8B精确度(%),括号内为基数变化.

blocks.en: Other base models. Table 11 reports the 8-task SFT recipe on two additional bases. InternVL3.5-8B improves from 29.3% to 62.8% on matched 200-item sets, with gains on every task. Qwen3-VL-4B reaches 62.6% on the first 200 items per task, comparable to the 61.6% reached by the trained 8B model on those items. Its available zero-shot result is 32.9% on all 500 items per task (Table 1 ); without its first-200 scores, we do not estimate a matched 4B training gain.
blocks.zh: 其他基础型号. 表11在另外两个基础上报告了SFT8任务配方。 InternVL3.5-8B在200套配套项目上从29.3%提高到62.8%,每项任务都有收获。 每件工作头200件物品的Qune3-VL-4B达到62.6%,与训练有素的8B型物品达到的61.6%相当。 其可获得的零射出结果为32.9%,每任务500项(表1);没有首-200分,我们估计没有对应的4B训练增益.

blocks.en: InternVL3.5-8B uses its native Hugging Face video path, which samples at most 16 frames per video, so it is compared only with its own base.
blocks.zh: InternVL3.5-8B使用其本土的Hugging Face视频路径,每段视频最多采样16帧,因此只能与自己的基数进行比较.
