blocks.zh: 表11:其他基础模型上的SFT. 每个任务前200项的SYNCR精度(%);训练完成的任务为粗体. 表1对所有500项任务的Quen3-VL-4B基数进行了评价,此处省略,因为没有对应的首-200分数。

blocks.en: C.3 Evaluation Without Answer Options
blocks.zh: C.3 没有答案的评价

blocks.en: Object Counting shows smaller multiple-choice gains than most other tasks. Exact-match scoring over four numeric options reports only whether a model lands on the right integer, so we also evaluate it open-ended, replacing the options with a request for a number and parsing the number from the response (Table 12 ). MRA is Mean Relative Accuracy ( Yang et al., 2025 ) ; ρ \rho is the Spearman correlation between predicted and true counts, which unlike MRA is unaffected by a uniform scale bias. Scored on 200 items for the Qwen models and 500 for InternVL3.5-8B, eight-task SFT raises MRA in all three families and raises the rank correlation between predicted and true counts by 0.11 to 0.24, with paired bootstrap intervals excluding zero.
blocks.zh: 对象计数显示的多选择增益比大多数其他任务要小. 准确的比对评分超过四个数值选项只报告一个模型是否落在正确的整数上,所以我们也评价它没有限制,用一个数字请求来取代这些选项,并从响应中解析数字(表12). MRA是平均相对准确性(Yang等人,2025年); ^rho是预测数和真实数之间的斯皮尔曼关系,这与MRA不同,不受统一比例偏差的影响. 在Quen型号的200项和在InternVL3.5-8B型号的500项上得分,八任务SFT将所有三个家族的MRA提升,并将预测数和真实数之间的排名关联提高0.11到0.24,对齐的靴子间隔排除0.

blocks.en: Table 12: Object Counting without answer options. Models answer with a number instead of choosing among four, scored by parsing the number from the response. Base and fine-tuned are scored on identical items.
blocks.zh: 表12:没有答案选项的对象计数. 模型用数字回答,而不是在4个中选择,通过从响应中解析数字得分. 基数和微调在相同项目上得分。

blocks.en: The same treatment applies to Multi-Angle Synchronization, whose answer is a pair of temporal offsets rather than a category. Standard open-weight checkpoints score 21.8–31.0% against a 25% chance rate; the four options do not show how accurately a model can estimate offsets directly. We therefore also ask for the offsets without answer options (Table 13 ). Because true offsets average 0.70 s in magnitude, replying “0 seconds” everywhere has a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.70 s.
blocks.zh: 同样的处理也适用于多角同步,其答案是一对时间抵消而不是一个类别. 标准开放重量检查点的得分是21.8–31.0%,而概率为25%;这四个选项没有显示一个模型能够如何准确估计直接抵消。 因此,我们还请求在不作答复的情况下予以抵销(表13)。 因为真实抵消了平均0.70秒的数值,在各地回答“0秒”时,平均绝对误差为0.70秒。

blocks.en: The Qwen3-VL-4B and InternVL3.5-8B base checkpoints have MAE of 0.71 and 0.73 s, close to the constant-zero reference. After fine-tuning, Qwen3-VL-4B reaches MAE 0.48 s and ρ = 0.75 \rho=0.75 , while InternVL3.5-8B reaches MAE 0.37 s and ρ = 0.90 \rho=0.90 .
blocks.zh: Qune3-VL-4B和InternVL3.5-8B基地检查站的MAE为0.71和0.73s,接近常数零。 微调后,Quen3-VL-4B达到MAE 0.38 s, ρ = 0.75\rho=0.75,而InternVL3.5-8B达到MAE 0.37 s, ρ = 0.90\rho=0.90.

blocks.en: MAE is in seconds; ρ \rho is the Spearman correlation between predicted and true offsets; | pred | |\text{pred}| is the mean magnitude of the predicted offsets.
blocks.zh: MAE为秒; ^\rho是预测和真实抵消之间的斯皮尔曼关联; ^ pred {\ text{pred} 是预测抵消的平均值 。

blocks.en: Table 13: Multi-Angle Synchronization without answer options. Models report the two offsets as numbers rather than choosing among four candidate pairs, on 200 items with both offsets scored (400 values).
blocks.zh: 表13:没有答案选项的多角度同步。 模型将两个抵消作为数字报告,而不是在四个候选对中选择,涉及两个抵消都得分的200个项目(400个数值)。

blocks.en: C.4 Controls on the Training Gains
blocks.zh: C.4 对培训成果的控制

blocks.en: Each control below tests one way the reported gains could be an artefact rather than learning: supervision that is not cross-video, answer-format familiarity, a single training seed, text regularities rather than video evidence, multiple testing, and priors installed by fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 下面的每个控制测试一种方法,即所报告的增益可能是一种人工活性而不是学习:监督不是跨视频,答案格式的熟悉,单一培训种子,文本规律而不是视频证据,多种测试,以及通过微调安装的前科。

blocks.en: C.4.1 Alternative Supervision at a Matched Budget
blocks.zh: C.4.1 相应预算的替代监督

blocks.en: The placebo tests the role of label correctness, but does not establish whether cross-video supervision is necessary: other spatially grounded training data might produce similar transfer. We therefore train a second arm on SAT ( Ray et al., 2024 ) , a published dataset of multi-frame spatial questions, holding the base, LoRA recipe, 15,960 examples, prompt and answer format fixed, with each SAT frame rendered as a one-second clip. It does not reproduce the result (Table 14 ): on the two real benchmarks SYNCR improves it moves the other way, by − 8.5 -8.5 and − 17.0 -17.0 points, and on the constructed ordering sets it loses 5.5 points on both where SYNCR gains 9.0 and 19.0; its one gain is VSI-Bench appearance order ( + 7.0 +7.0 ), the target closest to its own content, where SYNCR’s + 14.5 +14.5 is twice as large. Since SAT is image-based and we render it as clips, this tests its content under our format, so the claim is narrow: matched-budget supervision from a published spatial dataset does not produce these gains.
blocks.zh: 安慰剂测试标签正确性的作用,但并不确定交叉视频监督是否必要:其他基于空间的训练数据可能会产生类似的传输. 因此,我们在SAT(Ray等人,2024年)上训练第二个臂膀,这是一个已公布的多框架空间问题数据集,它持有基础,LORA食谱,15,960个例子,即时和答案格式固定,每个SAT帧作为一秒的片段提供. 它没有复制结果(表14):在SYNCR的两个真正基准上,SYNCR改进了移动方式,增加了-8.5-8.5和-17.0-17.0分,在构建的订单上,SYNCR增益9.0和19.0的均损失了5.5分;它的一个收益是VSI-Bench的外观顺序(+7.0+7.0),这个目标最接近它自己的内容,SYNCR的+14.5+14.5是它的两倍. 由于沙特德士古公司是以图像为基础的,我们把它编成片段,所以它用我们的格式测试它的内容,因此,它的说法是狭义的:从一个已公布的空间数据集进行匹配的预算监督不会产生这些收益。

blocks.en: Table 14: Alternative supervision at a matched budget. SAT ( Ray et al., 2024 ) trained on the same base, LoRA recipe, 15,960 examples, prompt and answer format. Only the content of the supervision differs.
blocks.zh: 表14: 相应预算的替代监督。 SAT(Ray等人,2024年)在同一基地接受训练,LORA食谱,15,960例,即时和回答格式. 只有监督的内容不同。

blocks.en: C.4.2 A Format-Matched Placebo
blocks.zh: C.4.2 A 格式装订的Plasebo

blocks.en: We train a placebo adapter on the same 15,960 examples, prompts, videos, option sets, and answer format as the 8-task SFT model, replacing each target with a randomly chosen wrong option.
blocks.zh: 我们训练一个安慰剂适配器 在同样的15,960例,提示,视频,选项集, 和答案格式 作为8任务 SFT模型, 替换每个目标 随机选择错误选项。

blocks.en: Training on the same inputs and answer format with incorrect labels does not reproduce the gains from correct supervision. The placebo performs below the base model on every SYNCR task and all five existing real-benchmark tasks reported in Table 15 , with losses of 7.5–35.0 points on the latter. Additional evaluations show declines on VSI-Bench appearance order (54.0% to 38.0%) and Assembly101 ordering (35.5% to 28.0%), where correctly labeled SFT reaches 68.5% and 44.5%, respectively. This control supports the importance of correct supervision, but does not isolate the contribution of answer-format familiarity. App. C.6.2 separately tests whether ordering gains persist under alternative answer formats.
blocks.zh: 同样的投入和回答格式的培训带有不正确的标签,并不重复正确监督的好处。 安慰剂在SYNCR任务和表15中报告的所有五个现有实际基准任务上都低于基准模型,后者的损失为7.5-35.0分。 其他评价显示,VSI-Bench的外观排位下降(54.0%至38.0%),Assembly101的排位下降(35.5%至28.0%),正确标注的SFT分别达到68.5%和44.5%。 这种控制支持正确监督的重要性,但并不孤立答案格式熟悉的贡献. App.C.6.2 单独测试在替代答案格式下订购收益是否继续存在。

blocks.en: Table 15: Format-matched placebo control. Same examples, prompts, videos, option sets and answer format as the 8-task model, with every target replaced by a randomly chosen wrong option.
blocks.zh: 表15:格式匹配的安慰剂控制. 与8任务模式相同的例子,提示,视频,选项集和答案格式,每个目标被随机选择的错误选项所取代.

blocks.en: C.4.3 Seed Variation
blocks.zh: C.4.3 种子变化

blocks.en: We repeat the 8-task SFT recipe with three training seeds, changing nothing else (Table 16 ). The per-task standard deviation is at most 5.1 points, on Spatial Measurement, and below 2.5 on six of the eight tasks; Sequential Ordering returns 98.0% in all three runs. Average accuracy is 61.6%, 61.8% and 64.6%, a mean of 62.6%; the main text reports the first seed throughout. Task-level differences smaller than the standard deviations here should not be read as effects, which applies in particular to the single-task versus multi-task comparisons of Sec. 4 and the transfer matrix of App. C.2 .
blocks.zh: 我们重复八项任务SFT的配方,配有三种训练种子,别无他法(表16)。 每任务标准偏差最多在5.1点,在空间测量上,在8项任务中的6项低于2.5; 顺序排序在所有3项运行中返回98.0%. 平均精度为61.6%,61.8%和64.6%,平均值为62.6%;正文报告全程第一种子. 任务级别差异小于这里的标准偏差不应被理解为效果,这尤其适用于Sec.4的单任务与多任务比较以及App.C.2的传输矩阵.

blocks.en: Table 16: Three seeds of the 8-task SFT recipe. Accuracy (%) on the first 200 evaluation items per task, for three runs of the same recipe differing only in training seed.
blocks.zh: 表16:8任务SFT配方的3个种子. 每项任务前200项评价的准确性(%),仅培训种子的三种相同方法不同。

blocks.en: C.4.4 Video-Dependence Contrast
blocks.zh: C.4.4 视频依赖对比

blocks.en: A fine-tuned model can improve with or without using the video evidence. Table 17 therefore compares each task’s training gain with videos to the gain on the same items with videos removed. We define the gain contrast as the full-video gain minus the no-video gain. It is 27.1 points for the eight-task mean, compared with a 28.9-point full-video gain, and exceeds 23 points on five tasks. For Route Planning, the contrast is only 10.0 points despite a 27.0-point full-video gain, because the model also improves by 17.0 points without videos. This contrast indicates how much larger the measured gain is when videos are present under this ablation; it does not partition the gain into causal visual and textual components.
blocks.zh: 微调后的模型无论是否使用视频证据都可以改进. 因此,表17将每个任务的培训收益与视频进行比较,并将同一项目的收益与删除的视频进行比较。 我们把收益对比定义为全视频收益减去无视频收益. 八任务平均分为27.1分,而全视频收益为28.9分,5项任务超过23分. 对于路由规划来说,对比点只有10.0分,尽管有27.0分的全视频收益,因为模型也改进了17.0分,没有视频. 这一对比表明,当视频出现在这种衰竭下时,所测量的收益有多大;它没有将收益分割成因果视觉和文字组件.

blocks.en: Table 17: Video-dependence contrast after 8-task SFT. Accuracy (%) with and without videos for the base and 8-task SFT models on matched 200-item sets. The gain contrast is the full-video training gain minus the no-video training gain.
blocks.zh: 表17: 8 任务 SFT 之后的视频依赖性对比。 匹配的 200 个项目组上, 数据库和 8 任务 SFT 模型的精确度(%) 。 增益对比是全视频训练增益减去无视频训练增益.

blocks.en: C.4.5 Multiplicity Correction
blocks.zh: C.4.5 多种矫正

blocks.en: The paper reports many paired comparisons, so we group them into the families reported together and give Benjamini–Hochberg adjusted values alongside the raw ones. For the eight-task SFT model against its base, seven of the eight SYNCR tasks are significant raw and all seven survive correction (Object Counting is significant under neither). Both real-benchmark transfer results survive: MVU-Eval Temporal Reasoning 68.0% to 75.5% ( p BH = 0.021 p_{\mathrm{BH}}=0.021 ) and CrossVid Procedural Step Sequencing 74.5% to 84.5% ( p BH = 0.008 p_{\mathrm{BH}}=0.008 ). Among the Thinking checkpoint’s eleven real-task comparisons none survives, including CVBench Temporal Reasoning ( p BH = 0.20 p_{\mathrm{BH}}=0.20 ), which we therefore do not treat as a finding. The 8-task RL model’s MVU-Eval Comparison gain survives ( p BH = 0.030 p_{\mathrm{BH}}=0.030 ). No conclusion drawn in the main text rests on a test that correction removes.
blocks.zh: 本文报导了许多对等的比较, 所以我们把它们归为一起报告的家庭, 对于八任务SFT模型对照其基础,SYNCR的八项任务中有七项是重大的原始任务,所有七项幸存的校正(Object Counting在两者都不重要). 两种真实基准转移结果都存活下来:MVU-Eval Timoral Reasoning 68.0%至75.5%(pBH = 0.021 p_{\mathrm{BH}}=0.021)和Cross 维德程序步骤将74.5%至84.5%(pBH = 0.008 p_{\mathrm{BH}}=0.008 ) 。 在思维检查点的11个实际任务比较中,没有哪个能够幸存下来,包括CV Bench Timoral Reasoning(pBH = 0.20 p_{\mathrm{BH}}=0.20 ) , 因此我们不认为这是一个结论。 8任务RL模型的MVU-Eval比较增益存活(p BH = 0.030 p_{\ mathrm{BH}}=0.030 ) 。 主文中没有任何结论依赖于修正去除的测试.

blocks.en: C.5 Generalization Beyond the Training Configurations
blocks.zh: C.5 概况 在培训配置之外

blocks.en: New structure. Each set in Table 2 (a) changes one task’s structure while retaining its simulator, wording, and option design. Sequential Ordering cuts the benchmark’s 200 CLEVRER validation videos into three or five gapped segments instead of four. Numerical Comparison and Kinematic Comparison compare three validation videos instead of two; Kinematic Comparison options contain each video’s fastest object and one video’s second-fastest. Multi-Angle Synchronization retains two videos from the first 200 benchmark items and asks for one offset. For the held-out camera rig (rig B), we render 200 new Kubric scenes with the simulation settings of App. A.1.2 but different cameras. Rig B moves the three cameras’ base positions to ( − 3.20 , − 10.80 , 8.60 ) (-3.20,-10.80,8.60) , ( 10.60 , 3.40 , 3.10 ) (10.60,3.40,3.10) and ( − 7.90 , 7.60 , 10.40 ) (-7.90,7.60,10.40) , widens the per-scene position jitter from uniform [ 0 , 1 ) [0,1) to uniform [ − 1.5 , 1.5 ) [-1.5,1.5) on each axis, and draws the focal length per scene from 28, 35 and 42 mm instead of fixing it at 35 mm. In the rendered scenes, each camera lies 12.5–23.5 units from its rig-A counterpart, against a mean scene-to-scene deviation of 0.48 units within the released rig. Scene seeds are offset so that no released scene is repeated, and the task is rebuilt with the released generator, option construction and letter balancing. Object Counting queries four categories in validation scenes. Each set has 200 items with balanced answer letters, and audited text-only rules stay within 6 points of chance. Route Planning is omitted because training already spans four to nine hops; structural shifts for Object Re-identification and Spatial Measurement would require new rendering.
blocks.zh: 新结构. 表2(a)中的每一组都改变一项任务的结构,同时保留其模拟、措辞和选项设计。 连续排序将基准的200个 CLEVRER 验证视频切成三、五个空隙片段而不是四个。 数字比较和Kinematic比较比较了三个验证视频而不是两个;Kinematic比较选项包含每个视频的最快对象和一个视频的第二快测试. 多角度同步从前200个基准项目中保留了2个视频,并请求一个偏移. 对于被搁置的照相机钻机(rig B),我们用App.A.1.2的模拟设置制造了200个新的Kubric场景,但相机不同. Rig B将三台相机的基座移动至(− 3.20,− 10.80, 8.60) (-3.20, 10.80, 8.60), (10.60, 3.40, 3.10) (10.60, 3.40, 3.10) (7.60, 10.40) (-7.90, 7.60, 10.10.40) (7.90, 7.60, 10.40), 将每台相机的基座从整齐的[0, 1, [0, 1] 拓宽为整齐的[− 1.5, 1.5] [-1.5, 1.5], 从每个场景的焦距为28, 35和42毫米而不是固定在35毫米. 在所制造的场景中,每台相机的钻机A对应机的12.5至23.5个单元与所释放的钻机内0.48个平均场景对场偏差相对应。 场景种子被抵消,从而不再重复发布场景,任务与发布的生成器,选项构建和字母平衡重建. 在验证场景中计算对象查询四类. 每套有200个有平衡的回答字母的项目,经过审计的文本规则只停留在6个机会点以内. 省略了路由规划,因为培训已经跨越4至9个跳板;对象重新识别和空间测量的结构转变需要新的渲染。

blocks.en: New simulator. Table 2 (b) keeps each task’s standard structure and wording but draws the videos from an engine that the task never used in training. Sequential Ordering, trained on CLEVRER, is cut in the same way from single Kubric camera views (5 s), Habitat walkthroughs (20 s, gaps of 1.2–2.4 s) and Habitat route clips. Object Counting, trained on Habitat, asks for the distinct objects of two shapes, or of three material–shape categories, across the three cameras of one Kubric scene; each camera’s metadata lists only the objects it sees, so objects are matched across cameras by shape and starting position, and items with objects visible in only one or two frames are dropped. Kubric videos come from the 627 scenes reserved for the Kubric evaluation sets and Habitat videos from the validation scenes, so no training video is reused. We fixed each set before evaluating any model on it, including the later CLEVRER swap of Object Counting, which counts two shapes across three consecutive windows of one video, with totals balanced over 3, 4 and 5 or more. Numerical Comparison has no swap, because Kubric logs every contact, including resting contacts, so collision counts have no clean ground truth; Multi-Angle Synchronization and Spatial Measurement need moving multi-camera scenes, which only Kubric provides. Text-only rules stay within 7 points of chance on every set. These tests hold out task–engine combinations, rather than engines entirely absent from the training mix.

blocks.en: C.6.1 Constructed Sets on Real Footage
blocks.zh: C.6.1 真实脚印上的构造集

blocks.en: We construct two ordering sets from Assembly101 ( Sener et al., 2022 ) and CMU Panoptic ( Joo et al., 2015 ) footage using SYNCR’s task format. Each contains 200 questions, with balanced answer letters; both were fixed before model evaluation (generation seed 20260917). Ground truth comes from the segment chronology. These sets test transfer while retaining the synthetic tasks’ question formats.
blocks.zh: 我们用SYNCR的任务格式从Assembly101(Sener等人, 2022年)和CMU Panoptic(Joo等人, 2015年)中建造两套订货机。 每一个问题包含200个问题,都有平衡的回答字母;两个问题都是在模型评价前固定的(生成种子20260917). 地面真理来自段纪元. 这些系统设置了测试传输,同时保留合成任务的问题格式。

blocks.en: Ordering. We sample a 20-second window from each selected source recording, divide it into four segments separated by 1.2–2.4-second gaps, and shuffle the segments. The correct option restores their original chronology, using SYNCR’s ordering distractor builder. Assembly101 uses static RGB recordings; Panoptic uses individual HD-camera streams from six sequences, with multiple windows per sequence. Models receive cropped clips without source timestamps, sampled at 2 FPS.
blocks.zh: 点菜 我们从每个选中的源记录中抽取一个20秒的窗口, 将其分为四个部分, 以 1.2–2.4 秒的间隔分隔, 并洗涤这些部分。 正确的选项可以恢复他们最初的编年史, 使用 SYNCR 命令的分散器构建器 。 Assembly101使用静态RGB录制;泛光学使用单个HD-camera流自6个序列,每个序列有多个窗口. 模型接收没有源时间戳的裁剪片段,样本为2 FPS.

blocks.en: EPFL ordering and synchronization. Both sets use the EPFL multi-camera pedestrian videos ( Fleuret et al., 2008 ) : the laboratory sequences 4p and 6p (four cameras each) and the campus sequence campus4 (three cameras), giving 11 synchronized fixed-camera streams at 360 × 288 360\times 288 . A recording is kept only if its camera files agree in duration to within 0.1 s. Neither set uses EPFL’s annotations; as for Assembly101 and Panoptic, the answer follows from how the clips are cut. The ordering set cycles through the 11 streams in shuffled order, so each stream contributes 18 or 19 of the 200 items, and each item is built as above, with the 20-second window at least 8 s from either end of the recording. The synchronization set rotates over the three recordings. Each item assigns three of the recording’s cameras, in random order, to Videos 1–3, draws a reference time uniformly between 8 s after the start and 12 s before the end, and draws three distinct start offsets of 0–24 frames at 12 FPS (0–2 s); each video is a 3-second (36-frame) crop beginning at the reference time plus its offset. The correct option gives the start times of Videos 2 and 3 relative to Video 1, and the three distractors come from independent repetitions of the same offset sampling, as in Multi-Angle Synchronization (App. A.1.2 ). Each set has 200 items with 50 correct answers per letter (generation seed 20260921).
blocks.zh: EPFL 订购和同步. 两套都使用EPFL多相机行人视频(Fleuret等人,2008年):实验室序列4p和6p(各4个摄像头)和校园序列4(3个摄像头),在360×288360\times 288上给出了11个同步固定相机流. 只有相机文件在0.1秒以内商定持续时间,才保留录音。 两个集都使用EPFL的注释;至于Assembly101和Panoptic,答案来自剪辑方式. 订单设定循环通过11个流以洗牌顺序进行,因此每个流贡献了200个项中的18个或19个,每个项都是按照上面的构造的,20秒窗口从录制的任意一端至少有8s. 同步集在三段录音上旋转. 每个条目按随机顺序为1-3视频分配3个录制的摄像头,在开始后8秒到结束前12秒之间统一绘制一个参考时间,并在12 FPS(0-2s)中绘制3个不同的0-24帧的起始偏移;每个视频是3秒(36帧)的收缩,从参考时间开始加其偏移。 正确的选项给出了视频2和3相对于视频1的起始时间,三个分光器来自独立重复相同的偏移采样,如多角同步(App. A.1.2.). 每套有200件物品,每封信有50个正确答案(生成种子20260921).

blocks.en: Panoptic re-identification. This set uses CMU Panoptic’s 3D body poses ( hdPose3d_stage1_coco19 ), which give each tracked person a persistent identity, together with the HD-camera calibration. Candidate windows start every 4 s, and a window qualifies only if at least four people are tracked; only the sequence 160422_ultimatum1 meets this. For each ordered pair of its HD cameras, people are ranked by the distance from the camera centre to their body centre (the mean of joints with confidence above 0.1, requiring at least five such joints), and people behind the camera are excluded. The question names one person by depth rank in Video 1, drawn from nearest to 4th nearest. That person must be at least 1.15 times farther from the camera than the next-nearer person and at least 1.15 times nearer than the next-farther one, so that the rank identifies a single person, and must be among the four nearest people in Video 2. The question asks for the person’s rank in Video 2; the four options are the fixed ranks from nearest to 4th nearest, so the distractors are the other three ranks. From the 739 qualifying candidates in random order, we keep the first 200 that give 50 items per correct rank. Each video is a 3-second clip from one HD camera beginning at the annotated frame, resampled to 12 FPS.
blocks.zh: 泛光学重新识别. 本集使用CMU Panoptic的3D体姿势(hdPose3d_stage1_coco19),使每个履带人物都具有持续的身份,同时使用HD-camera校准. 候选窗口每4秒启动一次,一个窗口只有在至少4人被跟踪的情况下才有资格;只有顺序160422_最后通牒1满足此要求. 对于其每对订购的HD摄像头,人们按照从摄像中心到身体中心的距离来排序(信心高于0.1的关节的平均值,需要至少5个这样的关节),摄像头后面的人被排除在外. 问号在视频1中按深度排出一人名,从最近的排到最近的第4名. 这个人必须离相机至少比邻人远1.15倍,离邻人至少比邻人近1.15倍,这样军衔才能识别一个人,并且必须是视频中四个距离最近的人之一. 2. 问题在于视频2中的人物等级;四个选项是从最近到最近四位的固定等级,因此分心者是其他三个等级. 从739名合格候选人的随机顺序来看,我们保留了首批200名每个正确军衔给出50个项目的候选人。 每段视频都是从一个HD相机的3秒剪辑,从附加说明的帧开始,重印到12个FPS.

blocks.en: nuScenes spatial measurement. This set uses the six surround cameras of nuScenes (v1.0-mini) and windows of six consecutive keyframes (3 s at 2 FPS), starting every two keyframes. An object can be named in a camera only if it belongs to one of eight categories (car, pedestrian, truck, bicycle, motorcycle, bus, trailer, construction vehicle), its projected box covers at least 0.4% of the frame in at least three of the six keyframes, and it is the only visible instance of its category in that camera over the window, so that “the bus in Video 2” refers to one object. Each item names four such objects drawn from at least three cameras; the videos are those cameras’ clips, and each option reads “Video k k : the ⟨ \langle category ⟩ \rangle ”. The question asks which object is farthest from, or nearest to, the recording vehicle. Range is the ground-plane distance from the annotated box centre to the vehicle’s ego pose, averaged over the window, so objects in different cameras are compared in one vehicle frame. The correct option is the object at the requested extreme, the other three named objects are the distractors, and an item is kept only if the answer beats the runner-up by at least 6 m. Because large objects such as buses remain above the visibility threshold at longer range, answer category is confounded with range; we therefore ask both directions and cap each answer category at nine items per direction. We also keep at most two items per window and rotate the correct option through letters A–D, which yields 70 items.
blocks.zh: nuScens空间测量. 本集采用nuScenes(v1.0-mini)的6个环绕相机和6个连续键框的窗口(3s at 2 FPS),每两个键框开始. 一个物体只有在属于八类之一(汽车,行人,卡车,自行车,摩托车,巴士,拖车,建筑车)的情况下,才可以在照相机中命名,其投影盒至少覆盖了六个键框中至少三个框的0.4%的帧,并且它是该照相机中唯一在窗户上可见的类别实例,因此"视频2中的巴士"指的是一个物体. 每件物品名称为至少从三个相机中抽取的4个此类物体;视频是这些相机的片段,每个选项为 " Video k : \\ langle 类 \\\rangle " 。 问题在于哪个物体距离录音车最远,或距离该车最近。 范围是地面飞机从注解箱中心到车辆自负的姿势,平均在窗户上,因此不同相机中的物体在一个车架上比较. 正确的选项是请求的极点上的对象,另外三个命名的对象是分流器,只有当答案至少将跑步器击败6米时才保留一个项. 由于公共汽车等大型物体在更长的距离上仍然高于能见度阈值,因此答题类别与射程相混淆;因此,我们按每个方向9个项目分别询问双方向和每个答题类别上限. 我们还将每个窗口最多保留两个项目,并通过字母A-D旋转正确的选项,该字母产生70个项目。

blocks.en: Because PSS shares SYNCR’s “Video i → i\rightarrow Video j j ” ordering-answer format, a gain there could reflect format familiarity rather than transfer, so we re-ran the same items, clips and correct orders in two answer formats SYNCR never produces: letters , where the clips are relabelled A–E and the answer is a letter string (“C, E, D, B, A”), and prose , where the answer is a sentence (“the third clip, then the fifth clip, …”). On 200 items, 8-task SFT improves Qwen3-VL-8B by 19.0 points in the letters format (57.0% to 76.0%, p < 10 − 5 p<10^{-5} ) and 8.0 in prose (77.5% to 85.5%, p = 0.011 p=0.011 ), against 10.0 in SYNCR’s own format (74.5% to 84.5%, p = 0.0012 p=0.0012 ); InternVL3.5-8B replicates it more strongly still, gaining 30.5 points in letters and 30.0 in prose with its 8-task model (Table 22 ).
blocks.zh: 因为PSS共享SYNCR的"Video i → i\rightarrow Video j j j"的指令-答题格式,所以那里得到一个收益可以反映格式的熟悉性而不是传输,所以我们用SYNCR两种答案格式重新排列相同的项目,剪辑和正确的顺序,SYNCR从不产生:字母,这些剪辑被重新贴上A-E的标签,答案是字母字符串(“C,E,D,B,A”)和流言语,答案是句子(“第三段,然后是第五段,......”)。 在200个项目上,8-任务SFT改进了Qune3-VL-8B字母格式的19.0分(57.0%至76.0%,p < 10 - 5 p < 10 > 5})和8.0字义(77.5%至85.5%,p=0.011 p=0.011),而SYNCR自己的格式为10.0分(74.5%至84.5%,p=0.0012 p=0.0012); InternVL3.5-8B更强烈地复制了它,用其8个任务模式获得了30.5个字母的分数和30.0个音素(表22).

blocks.en: The gain is largest in the format the training data never contains, which is the opposite of what format familiarity predicts, so we treat PSS as measuring transferred ordering rather than answer-template reuse.
blocks.zh: 收益最大的是训练数据从未包含的格式,这与格式熟悉度预测的相反,所以我们把PSS视为测量传输的订单,而不是解答-模板再利用.

blocks.en: Qwen3-VL 8-task RL changes MVU-Eval Temporal Reasoning and CrossVid sequencing by 0.5 points each and improves constructed real-video ordering by 3.0–5.0 points, well below the corresponding SFT gains. The exception is VSI-Bench appearance order, where RL gains 13.5 points and SFT → \rightarrow RL 14.0, as much as SFT: on that single-video benchmark the supervised stage is not what separates the models.
blocks.zh: Quen3-VL 图像 8-任务 RL 更改 MVU-Eval Timoral Reasoning and Cross 视序各0.5分,将构造的真视频订购量提高3.0–5.0分,远低于相应的SFT增益. 例外是VSI-Bench的外观顺序,其中RL获得13.5分和SFT →\rightarrow RL 14.0,与SFT一样多:在该单视频基准上,受监督的阶段不是将模型分开的阶段.

blocks.en: Applying GRPO to the 8-task SFT model leaves both ordering gains in place: MVU-Eval Temporal Reasoning is 76.5% (+8.5 over the base, exact McNemar p = 0.0009 p=0.0009 ) and CrossVid PSS 84.0% (+9.5, p = 0.0019 p=0.0019 ). Against its own SFT starting point, no task changes significantly in either direction (Temporal Reasoning +1.0, p = 0.63 p=0.63 ; PSS − 0.5 -0.5 , p = 1.00 p=1.00 ), and on PSS it is 9.0 points above RL from the base model ( p = 0.003 p=0.003 ). CVBench Temporal Reasoning rises by 8.0 points ( p = 0.18 p=0.18 ), the largest CVBench change for this model, without reaching significance on 75 items.
blocks.zh: 将 GPRO 应用到 8 任务 SFT 模式后, 两个命令增益都到位 : MVU-Eval Timoral Reasoning is 76.5% (+8.5 over the base,精确 McNemar p = 0.0009 p = 0.0009)和CrossVid PSS 84.0% (+9.5,p = 0.009 p = 0.0019 p = 0.0019)). 相对于自己的SFT起点,任一方向的任务都没有显著变化(Timperal Reasoning +1.0,p = 0.63 p = 0.63;PSS - 0.5 - 0.5,p = 1.00 p= 1.00),在PSS上,从基模型上比RL高9.0点(p = 0.003 p = 0.003). . . CV Bench Timoraluming 上升8.0点(p = 0.18),这一模型的最大CV Bench变化在75项上没有意义.

blocks.en: Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking, evaluated zero-shot, improves CVBench Temporal Reasoning from 50.7% to 66.7% (raw p = 0.029 p=0.029 ), the largest difference from Instruct among the eleven tasks. It does not survive multiplicity correction within that family ( p BH = 0.20 p_{\mathrm{BH}}=0.20 ; App. C.4.5 ), so we do not treat it as a finding. Its CrossVid PSS is 81.5% (+7.0, p = 0.059 p=0.059 ), compared with 84.5% for 8-task SFT. Its MVU-Eval Temporal Reasoning accuracy is 73.0% ( p = 0.093 p=0.093 versus Instruct). Both the Thinking checkpoint and SYNCR SFT show higher accuracy on real temporal tasks, consistent with the ordering improvement observed for Thinking on SYNCR (Sec. 3.2 ).
blocks.zh: Qune3-VL-8B-思维,评价零射,将CV Bench Temperal Reasoning从50.7%提升至66.7%(raw p = 0.029 p = 0.029),是11项任务中与Instruct最大的区别. 它在该家族内部无法幸存的多重矫正(pBH = 0.20 p_{\ mathrm{BH}}=0.20;App.C.4.5),所以我们不把它当作一个发现. 其CrossVid PSS为81.5%(+7.0,p=0.059 p=0.059),而8任务SFT为84.5%. 其MVU-Eval Temporal Reasoning精度为73.0%(p = 0.093 p = 0.093 对指令). 思维检查站和SYNCR SFT都显示真实时间任务的准确性较高,这与SYNCR思维(第3.2节)所观察到的顺序改进是一致的。

blocks.en: InternVL3.5-8B benefits from both training mixes, with 8-task SFT producing approximately twice the ordering gains of 4-task SFT (+28.0 versus +14.0 on PSS and +16.5 versus +8.0 on Temporal Reasoning). The 8-task model, which adds four tasks including Sequential Ordering, significantly outperforms 4-task on both ordering benchmarks (PSS p = 0.0004 p=0.0004 , Temporal Reasoning p = 0.0076 p=0.0076 ) and on CrossVid BU ( p = 0.0044 p=0.0044 ). The 4-task mix, trained on Multi-Angle Synchronization, Object Re-identification, Numerical Comparison and Object Counting, itself improves PSS by 14.0 points ( p = 2.3 × 10 − 4 p=2.3\times 10^{-4} ) and Temporal Reasoning by 8.0 ( p = 0.0052 p=0.0052 ); on the other nine tasks it does not differ significantly from either the base or 8-task model. The eight-task mix also uses more examples, so the comparison does not isolate which added task or the extra training exposure accounts for the larger gains.
blocks.zh: InternVL3.5-8B受益于两种培训组合,8任务SFT的订单收益大约是4任务SFT的两倍(PSS的+28.0对+14.0,临时原因的+16.5对+8.0)。 8任务模式增加了4项任务,包括顺序排列,在订购基准(PSS p = 0.0004 p = 0.0004),时序理性p = 0.0076 p = 0.0076)和CrossVid BU(p = 0.0044 p = 0.0044)上,4任务组合,在多角同步,对象再识别,数值比较和对象计数方面都明显超过4任务,它本身改进了PSS14.0分(P = 2.3 × 10 – 4 p = 2.3\tims 10^{-4})和时序理性8.0分(p = 0.0052 p = 0.0052 p 0.052),其他9个任务与基数或8 task模式都没有显著区别. 八任务组合还使用了更多的实例,因此比较并不孤立哪些任务增加了任务,或者额外培训曝光占得较大的收益.
